blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The landscape of satellite imagery time series datasets and boundary-pushing architectures for cropland segmentation has never been richer. However, in this gold rush, important truths are being missed on both fronts, as a drive for the most novel concepts or the largest datasets pushes finer details to the side. In this paper, we present our hybrid transformer-convolutional model, Cropland P arallel Atte ntion and R efinement N etwork for S egmentation (Cropland PAtteRNS), the first model to use self-attention mechanisms separately for each of the temporal, spectral, and spatial aspects of Sentinel-2 multispectral SITS data. To achieve fully-factorised attention in our proposed model, we introduce a novel parallel transformer architecture which significantly reduces the computational complexity of triple-factorised self-attention. We validate our architecture with an in-depth ablation study, and analyse the performance of our model against state-of-the-art crop segmentation models on multiple tile-size variants of the popular PASTIS and MTLCC datasets. Our findings show our model to outperform all others in the task of crop class segmentation, verified across multiple important segmentation metrics, with especially strong performance against compared models seen in the often under-reported parcel delineation quality, for which we use the Boundary IoU metric. We also find that flawed class groupings within datasets can have a significant negative impact on model performance, and report that alternate tile-size variants of crop segmentation datasets produce results incomparable to one-another, invalidating fair comparison between model performance when trained on different tile-sizes. Based on these findings, we suggest further work is required to standardise best practices for multiple aspects of constructing SITS crop segmentation datasets, and to identify any relations enabling future dynamic-tile-sizing for ideal model performance.
blocks.zh: 卫星图像时间序列数据集和耕地分割边界划定结构的景观从未如此丰富。 然而,在这场淘金热中,两条战线上都忽略了重要的真理,因为对于最新颖的概念或最大的数据集的驱动力将更细细的细节推向一边. 在本文中,我们介绍了我们的混合变压器-革命模型Cropland Parallel Attention和R efinement N etwork for S egmentation (Cropland PatteRNS),这是第一个对Sentinel-2多光谱SITS数据的时间,光谱和空间方面分别使用自留机制的模型. 为了在我们提议的模型中得到充分的注意,我们引入了一个新的平行变压器结构,大大降低了三要素自留的计算复杂性。 我们通过深入研究验证我们的建筑,并对照流行的PASTIS和MTLCC数据集的多个瓦片大小变体的先进作物分化模型分析我们模型的性能。 我们的研究结果表明,我们的模式在作物分类分解任务中表现优于所有其他模式,经过多个重要分解度量度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值 我们还发现,数据集内存在缺陷的分类组合可能对模型性能产生重大的负面影响,并报告说,作物分块数据集的交替的瓦片大小变体产生的结果与一个-另一个无法比较,在接受不同瓦片大小的培训时,使模型性能之间的公平比较无效. 根据这些调查结果,我们建议需要进一步开展工作,使构建SITS作物分块数据集的多个方面的最佳做法标准化,并查明能够使未来动态瓦片大小化以达到理想的模型性能的任何关系。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Crop type mapping is a long-established field in earth observation (EO) remote sensing, with essential and wide-ranging applications. From the first dedicated EO satellite mission, Landsat 1, a key advantage of the spawned Satellite Imagery Time Series (SITS) data products has been their potential to increase the dimensionality of available imagery data through multispectral and multi-temporal captures ( Wulder et al., 2022 ) . This lends SITS naturally to agricultural applications, where growth-cycle variations can only be captured within the temporal dimension, and the increasingly well-characterised discriminative power of banded spectral absorbance differences between plant species ( Thenkabail et al., 2012 ) . Modern advances in SITS data quality and accessibility in both commercial and public domains have enabled numerous studies across agricultural, environmental, surveillance, and many other fields. These developments have paralleled a surge in modern machine learning (ML) capabilities. As data landscapes outgrew feasible widespread manual classification, the use of ML in remote sensing has rapidly grown, with applications generally falling into the three categories of 1) Classification : assigning a single image-level class to a whole tile or region of interest (ROI); 2) Prediction : forecasting future trends using the temporal axis of the data; and 3) Segmentation : dividing imagery into classes at the pixel level (semantic), object level (instance), or both (panoptic) ( Kirillov et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 作物类型测绘是地球观测遥感中一个长期形成的领域,具有必不可少的广泛应用. 从第一次专门的地球卫星飞行任务Landsat 1开始,产卵卫星成像时间系列(SITS)数据产品的一个关键优势就是它们有可能通过多光谱和多时段捕获提高现有成像数据的维度(Wulder等人,2022年)。 这自然地将SITS推向了农业应用,在农业应用中,生长周期变化只能在时间维度内捕捉到,植物物种之间带状光谱吸收差异的日益显著的区别力(Thenkabail等人,2012年)。 在商业和公共领域SITS数据质量和可获取性方面的现代进展,使农业、环境、监督和许多其他领域的研究得以进行。 这些发展伴随着现代机器学习能力(ML)的激增。 由于数据景观超过了可行的广泛人工分类,在遥感中使用ML迅速增长,应用一般属于1的三类: 分类:将单一的图像级别分类划给整个瓦片或感兴趣的区域(ROI); 2)预测:利用数据的时间轴预测未来趋势;和3) 分裂:将图像分为像素级(语义级),物体级(内涵级),或两者(泛视级)(Kirillov等人,2019年).

blocks.en: Cropland remote sensing exploits all three of these applications. Analysing past, present, and predicted crop distributions and yields from SITS data is now a key tool for governmental and non-governmental organisations to monitor food security, agricultural sustainability, and environmental change ( Rembold et al., 2013 ) . A prime example is the European Space Agency’s Sentinels for Common Agriculture Policy ( ( European Space Agency, ) , Accessed May 2026), which aims to build high - volume SITS data pipelines from Sentinel - 1 ( Torres et al., 2012 ) and Sentinel - 2 ( Drusch et al., 2012 ; Berger et al., 2012 ) for crop type mapping, vegetation health assessment, and agricultural practice monitoring. These products support implementation of the European Union’s Common Agricultural Policy ( European Commission , Accessed May 2026), especially verification of per - parcel reported crop type for allocating farming subsidies ( Schmedtmann and Campagnolo, 2015 ) . When considering that farmers’ average income is well below overall mean income, such tools must be as accurate as possible in both crop type and parcel boundaries to ensure fair subsidy distribution. While other cropland remote sensing methods exist, such as low - altitude unmanned aerial vehicles ( Niu et al., 2022 ) and traditional aerial imagery ( Jacobus Prins and Van Niekerk, 2021 ) , satellite data offer unmatched spatial and temporal coverage at favourable cost, making SITS data the logical focus for large - scale crop type mapping.
blocks.zh: 耕地遥感利用了所有这些应用。 分析过去、现在和预测的作物分布和产量,从技术服务分类数据中分析,现在是政府和非政府组织监测粮食安全、农业可持续性和环境变化的重要工具(Rembold等人,2013年)。 欧洲航天局的 " 共同农业政策哨兵 " (欧洲航天局,2026年5月查阅)就是一个例子,其目的是建设来自哨兵-1(Torres等人,2012年)和哨兵-的量大SITS数据管道。 2 (Drusch等人,2012年;Berger等人,2012年),用于作物类型测绘,植被健康评估和农业实践监测. 这些产品支持执行欧洲联盟的共同农业政策(欧洲联盟委员会,2026年5月查阅),特别是核查每块报告的作物类型,分配农业补贴(Schmedtmann和Campagnolo,2015年)。 考虑到农民的平均收入远远低于总体平均收入,这些工具必须在作物类型和地块界限上尽可能准确,以确保公平分配补贴。 虽然存在其他耕地遥感方法,如低空无人驾驶飞行器(Niu等人,2022年)和传统的航空图像(Jacobus Prins和Van Niekerk,2021年),但卫星数据以有利的成本提供无与伦比的空间和时间覆盖,使SITS数据成为大面积作物类型绘图的逻辑焦点。

blocks.en: Supervised semantic segmentation of cropland has seen a particular influx of growth in recent years, in both models and datasets, largely due to the increasing availability of valuable ground truth data. Although performance boundaries are being continually pushed by novel architectures in this field, agricultural parcel boundary segmentation in particular remains challenging, with neighbouring parcels commonly seen either to be growing the same crop, or to be separated only by sub–spatial-resolution features such as fences ( North et al., 2019 ) . The growth in datasets presents further challenge. Many factors in dataset design lack standard practice or consensus, and with little study on the effects of these choices, the capabilities of contemporary models in the field may be undersold by flawed dataset constructions.
blocks.zh: 近年来,经过监督的耕地语义分解,在模型和数据集中都出现了特别增长的流入,这主要是由于可获取的宝贵地面真实数据越来越多。 尽管该领域的新建筑不断推动着性能界限,但农业地块边界划分尤其具有挑战性,相邻的地块通常要么种植同样的作物,要么只能通过栅栏(North等人,2019年)等次空间分辨率特征加以分隔。 数据集的增长提出了进一步的挑战。 数据集设计中的许多因素缺乏标准实践或共识,在对这些选择的影响研究不多的情况下,当代模型在领域的能力可能会被缺陷的数据集构建所掩盖.

blocks.en: This study examines and builds on these contemporary crop segmentation models and datasets. We firstly introduce our SITS crop segmentation model using a novel architecture of fully-factorised temporal-spectral-spatial attention, and also evaluate the continued relevance of convolutional components in transformer-heavy architectures through the addition of a hybridised convolutional refinement head. We then compare our model with several state-of-the-art models in the field, and analyse how informed crop-class selection and tile size choices in dataset design affect achievable segmentation performance. The key contributions of our work therefore follow as:
blocks.zh: 本研究审查并借鉴了这些当代作物分类模型和数据集。 我们首先采用全构时间光谱空间关注的新结构,引入了我们的STS作物分型模式,还通过增加混合式的分型精制头来评价变压器重构结构中进化成分的持续相关性. 然后,我们将我们的模型与该领域的几个最新模型进行比较,并分析数据集设计中明智的作物类选择和瓷砖大小选择如何影响可实现的分解性能。 因此,我们工作的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • The introduction of the first crop segmentation model to apply factorised self-attention jointly over spatial, spectral, and temporal dimensions in SITS data. We propose a novel parallel encoder architecture for the temporal and spectral branches, both to achieve computationally viability of this approach, and to widen the reception of raw unattended signals from the original SITS inputs to a greater proportion of the network. • Evidential findings to support the continued relevancy of hybridisations between attention and convolutional mechanisms in segmentation networks, improving performance significantly by leveraging the proven strengths of CNNS for spatial representations against the common trend of employing purely attention-based architectures. • A comparative study of SOTA SITS crop segmentation models across an unprecedented coverage of tile-size variants from multiple datasets, demonstrating that tile size, even within the same dataset, strongly affects results and prevents fair comparison between models trained with different tile sizes. Our results also show that flawed class selections and aggregations of multiple crop species can degrade crop segmentation performance to a greater extent than model architectural choices, highlighting the importance of considerate practices for involved crop classes in construction of future datasets. • We show our PAtteRNS model for crop segmentation to outperform existing SOTA models in key segmentation metrics, particularly in terms of parcel boundary quality, demonstrated via Boundary IoU as a measure of fine parcel delineation. We make our model publicly available for use and adaptation.
blocks.zh: • 支助 采用第一个作物分化模型,在空间、光谱和时间维度上联合应用空间、光谱和时间维度系数化自留。 我们为时间和光谱分支提出一个新的平行编码器架构,既实现这种方法的计算可行性,又扩大接收原始的无人处理信号,从最初的SITS输入到更大比例的网络。 · 支持分块化网络中注意力和转动机制之间持续关联的验证结论,通过利用CNNS在空间表现方面已证明的优势,与使用纯粹以注意力为基础的结构的共同趋势相比,大大提高了性能。 • 支助 对SOTA SITS作物分块模型进行比较研究,该模型覆盖了多个数据集的瓦片大小变体的前所未有的范围,表明瓦片大小,即使在同一个数据集内,也严重影响了结果,妨碍了不同瓦片大小的训练模型之间的公平比较。 我们的研究结果还表明,有缺陷的分类选择和多种作物种类的汇总比建筑模型选择更能降低作物的分化性能,这突出说明了在今后数据集的构建中考虑涉及作物种类的做法的重要性。 我们展示我们的作物分块的PattERNS模型,以超过关键分块测量标准中的现有SOTA模型,特别是在包裹边界质量方面,通过边界IoU作为精细包裹划界的尺度加以展示。 我们公布我们的模型供使用和修改。

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1 Basis of Deep Learning in Crop Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.1 深入学习作物分类的基础

blocks.en: Early ML efforts in cropland classification relied on hand-crafted spectral, temporal, and textural features, which were subsequently classified using models such as Support Vector Machines (SVMs), Decision Trees (DTs), and Random Forest (RF) ( Pal, 2005 ; Belgiu and Drăguţ, 2016 ) , or through unsupervised methods such as K-means clustering ( Kamilaris and Prenafeta-Boldú, 2018 ) . The shift in modern cropland classification to deep learning (DL) followed the popularisation of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for vision tasks ( Lecun et al., 1998 ; Krizhevsky et al., 2017 ; Mortensen et al., 2016 ; Victor et al., 2025 ) , whose ability to directly learn image feature representations suited the growing scale of available SITS data. While conventional CNNs were primarily designed for image-level classification tasks, the use of fully-convolutional networks (FCNs) then enabled dense per-pixel classification by replacing fully connected output layers with convolutional operations, making semantic segmentation more practical for agricultural imagery ( Long et al., 2015 ; Dyrmann et al., 2016 ; Zhu et al., 2017 ) . U-Net ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) , originally introduced for medical image segmentation, became one of the most popular early FCNs for segmentation tasks, with a proposed symmetric encoder-decoder architecture, along with skip-connections at each scale of representation to propagate finer spatially detailed information from encoder layers to the decoder. This architecture required comparatively limited labelled training samples while improving overall model speed and accuracy, particularly in the preservation of fine class borders, such as agricultural parcels, and as such saw rapid uptake within cropland segmentation ( Waldner and Diakogiannis, 2020 ; Niu et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2022 ) . DeepLabV3+ ( Chen et al., 2018 ) has seen more recent use in cropland segmentation ( Sharifzadeh et al., 2019 ; Li et al., 2022 ) and represents a more recent and higher-performing evolution of this core concept. This is primarily achieved through atrous convolutions and spatial pyramid pooling allowing for greater receptive fields ( Chen et al., 2017 ) , and a ResNet ( He et al., 2016 ) backbone to enable efficient deep feature extraction through residual connections. These methods are limited to single temporal state images and do not jointly learn spatial and spectral information within meaningful temporal features. A common solution is to hybridise CNNs with a temporal network, typically a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) ( Hochreiter and Schmidhuber, 1997 ) or Gated Recurrent Units ( Cho et al., 2014 ) , enabling learning of deep phenological crop features. These methods improved model performance, with implementations including CNN-LSTMs ( Finnegan et al., 2025 ) , ConvLSTM ( Shi et al., 2015 ) , and Bi-ConvGRU ( Rußwurm and Körner, 2018 ) . Some stand-alone RNN and LSTM models outperformed CNNs due to their multi-temporal reasoning ability ( Rußwurm and Körner, 2017 ) . Alternatively, instead of using RNNs to model temporal information, convolutional architectures have been directly extended to higher dimensions. 3D CNNs ( Ji et al., 2018 ) and U-Net3D ( Rustowicz et al., 2019 ) treat satellite image sequences as volumetric input, enabling joint learning of multi-dimensional features via 3D convolutions.
blocks.zh: 在耕地分类方面,早期的ML工作依赖于手工制作的光谱、时间和纹理特征,这些特征随后被分类使用模型,如辅助矢量机(SVMS)、决策树(DTs)和随机森林(RF)(Pal,2005年;Belgiu和Drăguţ,2016年),或通过K- Means集群(Kamilaris和Prenafeta-Boldú,2018年)等不受监督的方法。 现代耕地分类向深层学习(DL)的转变是随着进化神经网络(CNNs)的普及,用于视觉任务(Lecun等人,1998年;Krizhevsky等人,2017年;Mortensen等人,2016年;Victor等人,2025年),他们直接学习图像的能力呈现出适合不断扩大的SITS数据规模的特征. 虽然常规的CNN主要为图像级分类任务设计,但使用全演化网络(FCN)后,通过将全连接的输出层替换为演化操作,使得语义分区对农业图像更加实用(Long等人,2015年;Dyrmann等人,2016年;Zhu等人,2017年),使得每个像素的分类密度得以提高. U-Net(Ronneberger et al.,2015年)最初为医疗影像分解引入,成为分解任务中最受欢迎的早期FCN之一,它有一个拟议的对称编码器-解编码器架构,同时在每个表示尺度上都有跳转连接,以传播从编码器层到解编码器的更细密的空间详细信息. 这一架构需要相对有限的标记培训样本,同时提高整体模型速度和准确性,特别是在保护农业包裹等细小类别边界方面,因此在耕地分割中迅速吸收(Waldner和Diakogiannis,2020年;Niu等人,2022年;Li等人,2022年)。 DeepLabV3+(Chen等人,2018年)在耕地分割中出现了较近的应用(Sharifzadeh等人,2019年;Li等人,2022年),代表了这一核心概念的较近和较优效的发展. 这主要是通过原子演化和空间金字塔集合来实现的,这些集合允许更大的可接受领域(Chen等人,2017年)和一个ResNet(He等人,2016年)骨干,以便通过剩余连接有效挖掘深层特征。 这些方法仅限于单个时间状态图像,没有在有意义的时间特征内共同学习空间和光谱信息. 一个共同的解决方案是将CNN与时空网络混合使用,一般是一个经常性神经网络(RNN),如长期短期记忆(LSTM)(Hochreiter和Schmidhuber,1997年)或Gated Evenual Units(Cho等人,2014年),可以学习深苯学作物特征. 这些方法改善了模型性能,其实施包括CNN-LSTM(Finegan等人,2025年),ConvLSTM(Shi等人,2015年),以及Bi-ConvGRU(Rußwurm和Körner,2018年). 一些独立的RNN和LSTM模型由于其多时段推理能力而优于CNN(Rußwurm和Körner,2017年). 或者,不是利用RNNs来建模时间信息,而是直接将演化结构扩展到更高的维度. 3D CNNs(Ji等人,2018年)和U-Net3D(Rustowicz等人,2019年)将卫星图像序列作为量子输入,使得通过3D演化可以联合学习多维特性.

blocks.en: 2.2 Introduction of Vision Transformers
blocks.zh: 2.2 引入愿景变换器

blocks.en: The Vision Transformer (ViT) ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ) significantly advanced numerous computer vision tasks ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Arnab et al., 2021 ) . Based upon self-attention mechanisms ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , the application of the Transformer architecture to images was achieved through breaking them into tokenised non-overlapping patches, allowing for computation in the same fashion as tokens would receive in a natural language processing model. The basic structure of a ViT encoder is formed through repetitive layers of multi-head attention and feed-forward components, joined at each interface with a layer norm and a residual connection (Figure 2). These ViT models achieved excellent results at reasonable computational cost, but require far more labelled training data than prior methods. Initially proposed for classification, the ViT was soon extended to semantic segmentation with the Pyramid Vision Transformer (PVT) ( Wang et al., 2021 ) , which introduced a hierarchical feature pyramid for multi-scale representations while reducing the cost of standard self-attention, demonstrating the suitability of pure-transformer backbones for dense prediction tasks. Notable subsequent works included Swin Transformer ( Liu et al., 2021 ) and SegFormer ( Xie et al., 2021 ) , both attempting to further improve the computational viability of vision transformers. ViT offers global attention over the whole image but has quadratic complexity in the input sequence length. Swin Transformer reduces this to linear complexity by computing self-attention only within local patch regions, then mixing these regions in later encoder layers to approximate global attention. In contrast, SegFormer showed stronger performance by combining local and global attention by pairing a multi-scale transformer hierarchical encoder and a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP) decoder. Another key innovation in the ViT architecture was the classification c ​ l ​ s cls token introduced in BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) . Prepended to the embedded token sequence in transformer models, this single learned token was shown to suffice for classification, replacing the need to pool all tokens and thereby reducing model size while often improving accuracy.
blocks.zh: "视觉变形器"(ViT)(Dosovitskiy等人,2020年)显著推进了众多的计算机视觉任务(Huang等人,2024年;Arnab等人,2021年). 基于自我关注机制(Vaswani等人,2017年),变形器架构对图像的应用是通过将图像破解成象征性的非重叠补丁来实现的,允许以与在自然语言处理模型中接收的符文相同的方式进行计算. ViT编码器的基本结构是通过多头注意力和向导组件的重复层形成,在每个界面上与层规范和残余连接结合(图2). 这些虚拟技术模型以合理的计算成本取得了出色成果,但需要比以往方法更贴标签的培训数据。 最初提出分类,ViT很快与金字塔视觉变形器(PVT)(Wang等人,2021年)被扩展为语义分解,该变形器在降低标准自留成本的同时,为多尺度表示引入了分级特征金字塔,表明纯变形骨干适合密集预测任务. 随后的显著作品包括Swin Transformer(刘等人,2021年)和SegFormer(谢等人,2021年),两者都试图进一步提高视觉变压器的计算可行性. ViT为整个图像提供全球关注,但在输入序列长度上有四极复杂性. Swin Transformer通过仅在局部补丁区域内计算自我意向,然后将这些区域混合到后来的编码层,以近似于全球关注,将这一点降低为线性复杂性. 相比之下,SegFormer通过将一个多级变压器分级编码器和一个轻量级多层感应器(MLP)解码器配对,将局部和全局的注意力结合起来,表现出更强的性能. ViT架构的另一个关键创新是BERT引入的分类cl s cls sorder(Devlin等人,2019年). 准备在变压器模型中的嵌入式符号序列中,这个单一的学会式符号被显示足以进行分类,取代了集合所有符号的需要,从而降低模型大小,同时经常提高准确性.

blocks.en: While ViT operates in a two-dimensional space, its applicability can be extended to higher dimensions using ViViT ( Arnab et al., 2021 ) , which encodes video by extracting non-overlapping spatio-temporal tubelets and projecting them into embedded token sequences that jointly capture spatial and temporal aspects of the input. A key challenge in linking and lengthening token sequences is the quadratic complexity of self-attention. To address this, ViViT factorises self-attention in its transformer backbone, computing spatial attention then temporal attention sequentially over the embedded tokens, enabled by simple reshaping of the tokens before each attention step. The results showed that factorised self-attention is a strong approach for modelling multi-dimensional interactions. However, cross-attention can also do this ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Gheini et al., 2021 ; Wen et al., 2023 ) , by using queries from one token sequence and keys/values from another. This lets one sequence directly influence another and can be applied to spatial and temporal representations ( Wu et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 虽然ViT在二维空间运行,但其可应用ViViT(Arnab等人,2021年)扩展至更高维度,它通过提取非重叠的spatio-temporal管来编码视频,并把它们投影成嵌入式的符号序列,共同捕捉输入的时空方面. 连接和延长符号序列的一个关键挑战是自觉的四面体复杂性。 为了解决这个问题,ViViT在其变压器骨干中因子化了自我注意,计算了空间注意,然后依次在嵌入式符号上进行时间注意,在每次注意步骤前通过简单重塑符号来进行. 结果表明,考虑到因素的自我注意是建立多维相互作用模型的有力方法。 然而,交叉注意也可以做到这一点(Vaswani等人,2017年;Gheini等人,2021年;Wen等人,2023年),方法是使用一个符号序列的查询和另一个符号的密钥/值. 这让一个序列直接影响另一个序列,并可以应用于空间和时间表示(Wu等人,2023年).

blocks.en: 2.3 Contemporary Crop Segmentation Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 当代作物分块模型

blocks.en: Models tackling SITS crop segmentation problems have been shown to benefit greatly from the specific inclusion of multiple temporal samples ( Zhu et al., 2017 ; Pelletier et al., 2019 ; Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021 ) , aided by improved temporal resolution and range in SITS data and by reduced data storage and processing costs ( Rußwurm and Körner, 2018 ) . SITS sources with revisit periods under 7 days are now commonly and openly available ( Drusch et al., 2012 ; Planet Team, 2017 ) , providing over 50 temporal observations each year. Aside from external constraints on method choice, models that ignore temporal data for crop segmentation are usually passed-by in contemporary works. Similarly, although unsupervised ( Rivera et al., 2022 ) and semi-supervised ( Sharifzadeh et al., 2021 ; Finnegan et al., 2025 ) methods for SITS cropland segmentation have seen past popularity by reducing the need for extensive ground truth labels, improvements in ground truth label availability (Section 2.4 ) now see supervised models as the dominant choice for crop mapping in many areas. Leveraging temporal features, two seminal recent supervised crop segmentation models both use self-attention to process the temporal data axis.
blocks.zh: 具体纳入多个时间样本(Zhu等人,2017年;Pelletier等人,2019年;Fare Garnot和Landrieu,2021年),有助于解决SITS作物分解问题的模型证明大有裨益,这些样本得到了SITS数据中时间分辨率和范围的提高以及数据存储和处理成本的降低(Rußwurm和Körner,2018年)。 重新审视周期不到7天的SITS来源现已普遍公开(Drusch等人,2012年;Planet Team,2017年),每年提供50多个时间观测。 除了对方法选择的外部限制外,忽略作物分化时间数据的模型通常在当代作品中被通过. 同样,尽管无人监督(Rivera等人,2022年)和半人监督(Sharifzadeh等人,2021年;Finnegan等人,2025年)的SITS耕地分割方法通过减少广泛的地面真象标签需求,使过去受到欢迎,但地面真象标签提供情况的改善(第2.4节)现在将受监督的模型视为许多地区作物测绘的主要选择。 利用时间特征,两个具有开创性意义的近期监督作物分化模型都使用自觉处理时间数据轴。

blocks.en: The first of these, UTAE ( Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021 ) , combines a U-Net style CNN encoder-decoder architecture with attention mechanisms. Spatial relationships are handled by CNNs, and temporal dependencies are extracted at the lowest convolutional resolution by a lightweight transformer encoder. Temporal attention masks are interpolated upwards across all other resolutions levels, avoiding the cost of high resolution temporal encoding while still providing full temporal attention. Introducing the temporal attention mechanism achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance over all prior non-attention models.
blocks.zh: 其中第一种是UTAE(Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021年),结合了一种U-Net风格的CNN编码器-解码器架构与关注机制. 空间关系由CNN处理,时间依赖性通过轻量级变压器编码器在最低的演化分辨率上提取. 临时注意力罩在所有其他分辨率水平上向上插出,避免高分辨率时间编码的成本,同时仍然提供充分的时间注意力。 采用时间关注机制,在所有以往的非关注模式中实现最新性能。

blocks.en: The second of these models, TSViT ( Tarasiou et al., 2023 ) , removed all convolutional components, using a purely transformer-based architecture with a lightweight MLP head and per-dimension attention factorisation similar to ViViT. While ViViT found no difference in whether temporal or spatial attention came first in video encoding, TSViT shows a clear benefit to placing the temporal encoder before the spatial encoder, and argues this order is intuitive for cropland segmentation because per-crop phenology is highly discriminative. TSViT reports state-of-the-art performance across several benchmark datasets.
blocks.zh: 其中第二个型号是TSViT(Tarasiou等人,2023年),它移除了所有转录组件,采用了一种纯变压器结构,带有轻量级的MLP头部以及类似于ViViT的每段注意力分解分解. 虽然ViViT发现时间或空间注意力在视频编码中是第一,但TSViT显示出将时间编码器置于空间编码器之前的明显好处,并认为这一顺序对耕地的分割是直观的,因为每个作物的phenology具有高度的区别性. TSViT报告几个基准数据集的最新性能.

blocks.en: Although both models use temporal attention to varying degrees, we find that attention mechanisms along the spectral axis of SITS products remain relatively under-studied, even though indices derived from different spectral bands are a long-established tool in multispectral remote sensing ( Thenkabail et al., 2012 ; Peña-Barragán et al., 2011 ; Boyd et al., 2002 ) . Only a few recent works address spectral attention. Two studies apply transformer-based segmentation networks to spectral-spatial imagery for crop segmentation or classification, but neither factorises attention between spatial and spectral. One of them mainly compares different spectral band sets ( Al-Ruzouq et al., 2024 ) , the other uses various CNNs for feature extraction before the transformer encoder ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and both target a single crop species. Another study separates attention across different spectral bands before a cross-attention fusion ( Jayanthi and Brindha, 2026 ) , but lacks a temporal axis, does not use SITS, and employs only a few spectral bands. A recent work, SSF-TransUnet, factorises attention into spectral and spatial components for crop classification and uses separate ResNet-based feature-extraction branches for these two axes, but still lacks a temporal axis. That study uses 1 ​ m 1m resolution imagery from one satellite for the spatial branch and 10 ​ m 10m resolution imagery from another satellite for the spectral branch, which limits the method’s broader adaptability. To our knowledge, no prior work has used a fully factorised attention approach with spectral attention for SITS crop segmentation, despite the strong performance of factorised attention in multi-dimensional transformers in recent years.
blocks.zh: 虽然这两种模型都在不同程度上使用时间注意,但我们发现,沿SITS产品光谱轴的注意机制仍然相对研究不足,尽管不同光谱带产生的指数是多光谱遥感方面一个早已确立的工具(Thenkabail等人,2012年;Peña-Barragán等人,2011年;Boyd等人,2002年)。 最近只有几部作品涉及光谱关注. 两项研究将变压器分层网络应用于光谱-空间图像,用于作物分层或分类,但两者都未能将空间和光谱之间的注意力因素化. 其中一种主要比较不同的光谱波段集(Al-Ruzouq等人,2024年),另一种使用各种CNN在变压器编码器前进行特征提取(Wang等人,2025年),两者都针对单一作物物种. 另一项研究将不同光谱波段的注意力分开,然后进行跨视聚变(Jayanthi and Brindha, 2026),但缺乏时间轴,不使用STS,只使用少数光谱波段. 最近的一项工作——SSF-TransUnet,将注意力纳入光谱和空间成分,用于作物分类,并为这两个轴使用单独的基于ResNet的特征提取分支,但仍然缺乏时间轴. 该研究使用1米1的分辨率图像用于空间分支,10米10的分辨率图像用于光谱分支,这限制了该方法更广泛的适应性。 据我们所知,尽管近年来多维变压器的多维注意性表现很强,但以前的工作并未对SITS作物的分片采用光谱注意的完全因地制宜的注意方法。

blocks.en: Recent works show that modern DL architectures, including RNNs ( Rußwurm and Körner, 2018 ; Turkoglu et al., 2021 ) and attention mechanisms ( Rußwurm and Körner, 2020 ; Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021 ) , can jointly learn the masking of cloud alongside crop type classifications in SITS segmentation tasks. This significantly lowers the entry barrier for SITS segmentation and allows models to achieve excellent results without explicit cloud-handling procedures. A notable omission in most reviewed crop class segmentation studies is an assessment metric for parcel boundary quality, despite its importance for verifying self-reported parcel boundaries in crop subsidy and land management systems. While segmentation methods can reach high performances using traditional segmentation metrics such as Overall Accuracy (OA) or Mean Intersection over Union (mIoU), these can fail to represent how consistent a model performs in boundary pixel placement ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Several works focus specifically on agricultural boundary delineation, rather than generalised crop class segmentation, yet none converge on any single ideal metric to quantify boundary accuracy ( North et al., 2019 ; Waldner and Diakogiannis, 2020 ) . This indicates that SITS crop mapping has not yet adopted a widely suitable metric for evaluating boundary quality in segmentation results.
blocks.zh: 近期的作品显示,现代DL建筑,包括RNNs(Rußwurm and Körner, 2018;Turkoglu等人, 2021)和关注机制(Rußwurm and Körner, 2020;Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021),可以在SITS分化任务中共同学习云与作物类型分类的遮掩. 这大大降低了SITS分离的进入屏障,使模型在没有明确的云处理程序的情况下能够取得优异的结果. 大多数经过审查的作物分类分块研究中一个明显的遗漏是地块边界质量的评估指标,尽管它对核实作物补贴和土地管理系统中自报的地块边界很重要。 虽然分解方法可以使用传统的分解度量,如总体精确度(OA)或平均交叉度(mIoU)来达到高性能,但这些方法不能代表一个模型在边界像素布置中如何发挥一致性(郑等人,2026年). 若干作品具体侧重于农业边界的划定,而不是一般的作物分类划分,然而,没有一部作品集中到任何单一的理想指标上,以量化边界准确性(North等人,2019年;Waldner和Diakogiannis,2020年)。 这表明,SITS作物测绘尚未采用广泛适用的衡量尺度来评价分块结果的边界质量。

blocks.en: 2.4 Contemporary Crop Segmentation Dataset Landscape
blocks.zh: 2.4 当代作物分区数据集景观

blocks.en: For many years the NASA Landsat Series of satellites was a primary source for crop type mapping ( Boyd et al., 2002 ; Sharifzadeh et al., 2019 ) . More recently, Sentinel-2 and numerous commercial satellites have been used more often ( Garioud et al., 2026 ; Victor et al., 2025 ) , greatly increasing the volume of available SITS raw data and facilitating accessibility of SITS data analysis as well as the production of cropland semantic segmentation datasets ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Sykas et al., 2021 ; Kondmann et al., 2021 ) based on both public and commercial satellite imagery. For many of these, the need for ground truth labels is met by public access to government databases of crops in each parcel, typically those used for subsidy control ( Victor et al., 2025 ) . This single source type has generated many high-quality supervised learning datasets with large numbers of labelled crop parcels, suitable even for data-hungry architectures ( Schneider et al., 2023 ) . However, this diversity has also produced inconsistent practices, including translation errors in crop class names, aggregate classes containing different sub-crops across datasets, and uneven recognition of crop seasonal variants ( Schneider et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 多年来,美国航天局Landsat系列卫星是作物类型测绘的主要来源(Boyd等人,2002年;Sharifzadeh等人,2019年)。 最近,哨兵-2号和许多商业卫星被更经常地使用(Garioud等人,2026年;Victor等人,2025年),大大增加了现有的STS原始数据的数量,便利了SITS数据分析的获取,也便利了根据公共和商业卫星图像制作耕地语义分类数据集(Zhang等人,2025年;Sykas等人,2021年;Kondmann等人,2021年)。 对其中许多人来说,通过公众查阅政府每个包裹的作物数据库,特别是用于补贴控制的数据库,就满足了地面真实标签的需要(Victor等人,2025年)。 这种单一来源类型产生了许多高质量的有监督的学习数据集,并附有大量标记的作物包裹,甚至适合数据饥饿结构(Schneider等人,2023年)。 然而,这种多样性也造成了不一致的做法,包括作物类名称的翻译错误、包含不同亚作物的汇总类跨数据集,以及对作物季节性变种的识别不均衡(Schneider等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Generally, naming errors are traceable, independent of method results, and therefore not covered here. Some crop classes, even when taxonomically well defined, have less homogenous ground coverage than others as seen with ‘Meadows’, which contains many individual coverage species, or orchard and vineyard-based crops, where the primary species is interspaced with grasses and other ground coverage. As these are still valid taxonomical classifications, we term these classes as ‘Non-Homogenous’.
blocks.zh: 一般来说,命名错误是可以追踪的,独立于方法结果,因此此处没有涵盖. 某些作物类别,即使分类明确,与 " Meadows " (包含许多个别的覆盖物种)或果园和葡萄园作物(主要物种与草类和其他地面覆盖相间)相比,其单一的地面覆盖率也较低。 由于这些分类仍然有效,我们将这些分类称为“非同类分类”。

blocks.en: A more common problem is how crop class taxonomies are chosen and grouped. Some datasets merge seasonal variants of a crop (e.g., ‘Rapeseed’) into a single class ( Rußwurm and Körner, 2018 ) , while others distinguish ‘Winter Rapeseed’ ( Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021 ) but omit the ‘Spring’ and ‘Summer’ variants ( Schneider et al., 2025 ) , making the true overlap of these crops across datasets unclear. We term this grouping practice as ‘Seasonal Aggregate’ classes. Elsewhere, broad aggregate labels group taxonomic and phenological differences across multiple crops, ignoring heterogeneity in spectral and temporal features and its potential impact on model performance. For instance, the popular PASTIS dataset groups fruits, vegetables, and flowers as one class ( Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021 ) . We term these groupings as ‘Taxonomical Aggregate’ classes. These inconsistencies mean a class boundary in one dataset may not correspond to any meaningful boundary in another, complicating accuracy comparisons across studies and potentially inflating or deflating reported performance depending on how forgiving or strict the underlying taxonomy is. These groupings may be especially harmful in long-term studies, preventing models from using region-specific planting windows.
blocks.zh: 比较常见的问题是作物类分类是如何选择和分组的。 一些数据集将作物的季节性变体(如 " Rapeseed " )合并为一个单一的类别(Rußwurm和Körner, 2018年),而另一些数据集则区分了 " Winter rapesed " (Fare Garnot和Landrieu, 2021年),但省略了 " Spring " 和 " Summer " 的变体(Schneider等人, 2025年),使得这些作物在不同数据集之间的真实重叠不清. 我们把这种分组做法称为“海上综合”课程。 在其他地方,广泛的聚合标签将多种作物的分类学和苯学差异分类,忽略了光谱和时间特征的异质性及其对模型性能的潜在影响。 例如,受欢迎的PASTIS数据集将水果、蔬菜和花卉分成一个类(Fare Garnot和Landrieu,2021年)。 我们把这些组合称为“税制综合”类。 这些不一致之处意味着一个数据集中的类边界可能与另一个数据集中任何有意义的边界不符,使不同研究的精确度比较复杂化,并可能因基本分类的宽容或严格程度而夸大或夸大所报告的业绩。 这些组合在长期研究中可能特别有害,使模型无法使用特定区域的种植窗口。

blocks.en: Another often seen flaw is the inclusion of only a few dominant classes within a study or dataset ( Rustowicz et al., 2019 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Rivera et al., 2022 ; Jacobus Prins and Van Niekerk, 2021 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) , omitting minority classes, which may still account for a large share of cropland in the study area. This is often done to balance class populations, however this artificial boost in model performance may not reflect real world deployment capabilities ( Turkoglu et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 另一个经常看到的缺陷是在研究或数据集中只包含少数主导阶层(Rustowicz等人,2019年;Li等人,2022年;Rivera等人,2022年;Jacobus Prins and Van Niekerk,2021年;Yan等人,2026年),省略少数阶层,这些阶层在研究地区仍然占耕地的很大份额. 这常常是为了平衡阶级人口,然而模型性能的这种人为的提升可能无法反映真实世界的部署能力(Turkoglu等人,2021年).

blocks.en: The final aspect of the dataset standardisation reviewed is the choice of tile size. Datasets use a wide range of sizes, in both pixel dimensions and spatial extent. We find no studies that explicitly analyse how tile size in constructed crop segmentation datasets affects model performance, or that compare a single model’s performance across multiple tile sizes.
blocks.zh: 审查的数据集标准化的最后方面是瓦片大小的选择. 数据集在像素维度和空间范围上都使用广泛的大小. 我们发现没有任何研究明确分析构造的作物分块数据集中的瓦片大小如何影响模型性能,或者比较单个模型在多个瓦片大小上的性能.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We selected datasets with predefined tile-size variants and similar class counts, localities, and temporal ranges, favouring those with many crop classes, temporal samples, and data points to better assess real-world performance. This led to using two Sentinel-2-derived datasets, each with two previously used or original tile-size variants. The first dataset, PASTIS ( Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021 ) , covers French agricultural parcels across 4 separate Sentinel-2 full-size tiles, with data provided by the French Land Parcel Identification System. The second dataset, MTLCC ( Rußwurm and Körner, 2018 ) , covers a much smaller geographical spread within Germany, but has a denser coverage of parcels within this area, provided by the Bavarian Ministry of Food, Agriculture and Forestry. Figure 2 shows the spatial extent of the two datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了带有预定义的瓦片大小变量和类似类数、地点和时间范围的数据组,偏爱那些具有许多作物类别、时间样本和数据点的数据集,以便更好地评估现实世界的表现。 这导致使用两个Sentinel-2衍生数据集,每个数据集都有两个以前使用的或原瓷砖大小的变体. 第一个数据集PASTIS(Fare Garnot和Landrieu,2021年)覆盖了4块独立的Sentinel-2全尺寸瓦片的法国农业包裹,数据由法国土地Parcel识别系统提供. 第二个数据集MTLCC(Rußwurm and Körner, 2018)覆盖了德国国内更小的地理分布,但这一地区的包裹覆盖度更密集,由巴伐利亚州粮食,农业和林业部提供. 图2显示两个数据集的空间范围。

blocks.en: Figure 2: The geographical extent of the two datasets selected for this study across France and Germany.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 法国和德国为本研究选定的两个数据集的地理范围。

blocks.en: Table 1 gives the characteristics of both Datasets. For both datasets, the Sentinel-2 20 ​ m 20m and 60 ​ m 60m spatial resolution bands were bi-linearly interpolated to the 10 ​ m 10m resolution for algorithmic simplicity and compatibility. PASTIS has a single temporal variant, running from September 2018 to November 2019, and MTLCC has two temporal variants, 2016 and 2017. Because the MTLCC ground truth labels differ between years and are not cross-compatible, we used the 2016 variant for its larger sample size. Both datasets contain cloudy data in some temporal bands of each tile, adding challenge and realism to model testing. The total amount of crop classes (Table 7 ), is similar between datasets, although with only partial overlap, allowing for a greater evaluation of the performance of the model against a variety of crops.
blocks.zh: 表1列出了这两个数据集的特征。 对于两个数据集,Sentinel-2 20米20米和60米60米空间分辨率波段被双线内插到10米10米分辨率上,以进行算法简单和兼容. blocks.en: Both datasets include a ‘Background‘ class alongside their main crop classes, but the PASTIS dataset also introduces a ‘Void‘ class, which is an additional concern. Any crop parcel in the original ground truth whose area lies more outside the tile than inside, or whose crop class is not in the PASTIS dataset, is labelled as ‘Void’. This differs from ‘Background‘ and introduces several issues, mainly that void crop parcels within a tile can confuse learning and inflate a model’s reported false positive rate due to potentially containing otherwise valid crop classes. Consequentially, ground truth parcels of the ‘Void’ class are masked during learning and metric evaluations for PASTIS, nullifying the effects of this class on the models. Differing in approach, in MTLCC, crops not included in the label set but present in a tile remain labelled as ‘Background‘. Models trained on PASTIS thus have a theoretical performance advantage, as parcels of non-included classes are removed, reducing label confusion. Merging the ‘Void‘ and ‘Background’ classes in PASTIS could be considered, but it would still leave a proportion of otherwise-valid crop class parcel segments at tile boundaries classified as ‘Background’ and so retain the issue of inflated crop class false positives. Our decision not to mask the ‘Background’ classes is motivated in Section 3.9 .

blocks.en: Our embedded patches are augmented with positional embeddings p ​ o ​ s pos and c ​ l ​ s cls tokens. Temporal positional encodings use an embedded normalised value representing each capture date’s relative position between the sequence start and end dates(details in section 3.6 ). A c ​ l ​ s cls token is a learnable d d -dimensional embedding that serves as a fixed-size summary of a tile; at the output, its state directly represents the predicted pixel classes. Following ( Tarasiou et al., 2023 ) , we use k k and c ​ l ​ s cls tokens as the baseline representation size, where k k is the number of dataset classes, giving c ​ l ​ s ∈ ℝ k × d cls\in\mathbb{R}^{k\times d} . After these additions, a token sequence consists of concat ( c ​ l ​ s , 𝐱 + p ​ o ​ s ) ∈ ℝ N × ( k + T ) × d (cls,\mathbf{x}+pos)\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times(k+T)\times d} . This token sequence is passed to the temporal transformer, which then operates over each of the N N patch positions, attending across the T T temporal tokens at that position to model the temporal dynamics of that patch over the observed sequence. After the temporal transformer, we keep the k k and c ​ l ​ s cls token representations at each patch position and discard the other temporal outputs, resulting in a tensor of shape N × k × d N\times k\times d . The N N patch-level representations, each with k k per-patch c ​ l ​ s cls tokens, are flattened and projected through a learned linear layer into the spatial embedding space, with a matching embedded dimension size to the temporal embedding. A learned spatial positional encoding p ​ o ​ s ∈ ℝ N × d pos\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times d} is added to the projected sequence before it enters the spatial transformer, which attends over all N N patches so each patch can incorporate contextual information from the tile. The output of the spatial transformer undergoes an ‘unpatch’ operation, expanding the raw outputs of shape N × d N\times d via a linear layer to N × ( P 2 ⋅ k ) N\times(P^{2}\cdot k) , which is then rearranged back to the tile’s original spatial arrangement at full pixel resolution. The produced output tensor of shape k × H × W k\times H\times W is suitable for a ​ r ​ g ​ m ​ a ​ x argmax classification on a per-pixel basis.

blocks.en: This baseline factorised transformer crop segmentation model now forms the starting block for our proposed model. Because our transformer model requires token sequences of equal length, we pad samples with fewer image capture dates along the temporal axis with 0. We opted to pad rather than interpolate to not introduce unknown biases into experiments. Pad-masking is used in the attention mechanisms of our architecture to track these padded temporal bands. Before changing the architecture, the main way to improve performance in this vision-transformer model is to adjust the patch size P P . Reducing P P has been shown to improve ViT-based models on dense prediction tasks ( Xie et al., 2021 ; Tarasiou et al., 2023 ) , but it directly increases the computational cost for a given model. Therefore, we do not fix the operating patch size in the architecture; instead, we keep it task-dependent and evaluate multiple patch sizes to assess the costs and benefits of this refinement.

blocks.en: 3.3 Proposed Parallel Temporal-Spectral Attention Structure
blocks.zh: 3.3 拟议的平行临时-特定注意结构

blocks.en: When proposing a spectral data axis equal in importance and implementation to the temporal component of the baseline factorised model, an initial intuition is to arrange the temporal, spectral, and spatial components sequentially. In contrast, we propose a factorised architecture with parallel spectral and temporal components, each processing patched representations of the original SITS data, followed by the spatial transformer operating on embedded representations already attended by each parallel primary transformer block. This architecture is illustrated via Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 在提出一个与基准因子化模型的时间部分具有同等重要性和执行程度的光谱数据轴时,最初的直觉是按顺序排列时间、光谱和空间部分。 相比之下,我们提出一个具有平行光谱和时间组件的因子化结构,每个处理补丁的原始STS数据的表示,然后是每个平行主变压器块已经参与的嵌入式表示上的空间变压器。 这种结构通过图3加以说明。

blocks.en:
Instead of sequentially processing temporal and spectral dimensions, where the second transformer attends to a representation already processed by the first, our dual-tokenisation strategy lets the model learn temporal and spectral dependencies independently from the same spatial patches, so both transformers operate in parallel on the original embedded SITS data.
In contrast, a sequential architecture that retains high-dimensional token representations between transformers produces very large intermediate activations. Since self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length, this greatly increases computation and memory relative to our parallel design; we have explored the sequential architecture and observed an approximate 5-fold increase in multiply-accumulate operations (MACs) for the sequential model without token reduction between transformers. Restricting the intermediate representation to class tokens cuts this cost but may remove information, especially for the third transformer in the sequential model which would receive twice-compressed token representations, limiting it’s ability to model complementary relationships.
blocks.zh:
我们的双键化策略让模型从同一个空间补丁中独立学习时间和光谱依赖性,而不是按顺序处理时间和光谱维度,即第二变压器处理第一个变压器已经处理过的表示,因此两个变压器在原始嵌入式SITS数据上并行运行.
与此相对照,一个在变压器之间保留高维符号表示的相继架构会产生非常大的中间激活. 由于自注意的尺度以序列长度为四倍,这比我们的平行设计大大提高了计算和内存;我们探索了相继架构,观察到相继型号的乘积操作(MAC)大约增加了5倍,而变压器之间没有象征性的减少. 将中间表示限制在类符号上会减少这种成本,但可能会删除信息,特别是顺序模型中的第三个变压器,该变压器将接受两次压缩的表示,从而限制了它模拟互补关系的能力。

blocks.en: Because our model uses two parallel representation paths, the two sets of k k c ​ l ​ s cls tokens output by the temporal and spectral transformers must be merged. We implement and evaluate several cross-attention methods for this fusion block. Unlike self-attention, cross-attention takes its query and key/value pairs from different sources rather than the same sequence. Given one sequence as an originating query Q Q , and another as a contextual key/value pair K , V K,V , the output is computed through standard scaled dot-product attention. This allows one representation to selectively pull information from the token sequence in a learned fashion, therefore allowing our spectral or temporal branches the opportunity to exchange information prior to fusion that could be used to represent complex spectral-temporal relationships. It is also possible in a paired input such as our architecture for both token sequences to attend each other in a balanced fashion. The four fuse blocks are shown in Figure 4 and described below.

blocks.en: Although outputs from our spatial transformer block can be directly restructured into the original tile pixel layout, making the architecture purely attention-based, we are aware of the established strengths of CNNs for spatially complex tasks. We therefore add an optional Convolutional Refinement Head (CRH), which operates on the unpatched transformer outputs of shape k × H × W k\times H\times W . Positioning the CRH directly before the model output (see Figure 5 ) maximizes its portability to future architectures, including purely attention-based models like ours and more traditional models that already use convolutions. A small exploration of possible combinations of layers and convolution sizes was undertaken, while aiming to minimise any computational cost. Based on this, our proposed CRH uses three convolutions: a 3 × 3 3\times 3 layer that expands the k k input channels to e = max ⁡ ( 32 , 4 ​ k ) e=\max(32,4k) , a second 3 × 3 3\times 3 layer that processes this representation, and a final 1 × 1 1\times 1 layer that projects back to k k channels. The first two convolutions preserve the H × W H\times W spatial size via padding and are followed by batch normalisation and ReLU; the final 1 × 1 1\times 1 layer is left linear without normalisation or activation so that it can learn unrestricted corrections to the original ( k × H × W ) (k\times H\times W) output space. This residual is added element-wise to the spatial transformer’s unpatched output, so the CRH refines rather than replaces the class logits. Visualised in Figure 5 , our proposed architecture is now fully detailed.

blocks.en: 3.6 Temporal Encodings
blocks.zh: 3.6 临时编码

blocks.en: We observed two dominant date indexing methods in the literature. The first, Day of Year (DOY), poses the positional encodings by the given date within its calendar year, such that the minimum value is January 1 st , and the maximum is December 31 st with a pre-normalisation range of 0 through 365. The second, which we term Days since Reference Date (DSRD), uses either the exact first chronological capture date within the dataset, or a date just before the first capture as the minimum value for pre-normalisation capture dates. As an example, for PASTIS, a reference date of September 16 th 2018 is used, 1 day before the first capture, and a final capture date of October 27 th 2019 gives a range of 0 through 407.
blocks.zh: 我们在文献中观察到两种主要的日期索引方法。 第一种是年日(DOY),在其历年内在给定日期前提出位置编码,这样最小值为1月1日st,最高值为12月31日st,预先规范化范围为0至365. 第二,我们自参考日期(DSRD)起将Days命名为Days,要么在数据集内使用准确的第一个时间顺序捕捉日期,要么在第一个捕捉日期之前就使用一个日期作为初始化捕捉日期的最小值. 例如,对于PASTIS,使用2018年9月16日的参考日期,即第一次捕捉的前一天,2019年10月27日的最后捕捉日期给出的捕捉范围为0至407.

blocks.en: As the selected datasets have limited multi-year coverage, extensive comparison between them would be out of scope; both are instead treated equitably within the single-year MTLCC data. This choice might have an effect on model performance within PASTIS, as its temporal span exceeds one year and its start date does not align with the start of a calendar year. We experimentally assess the impact of this potential performance factor in the ablation study reported in Section 4.1 . For all other experiments, we use DSRD encoding for our model to better standardise between PASTIS, with it’s offset temporal span from a calendar year, and MTLCC, which covers the 2016 calendar year. For comparative models, we use the original implementation’s chosen encoding method.
blocks.zh: 由于所选数据集的多年覆盖面有限,因此它们之间的广泛比较将超出范围;相反,两者都在单一年份的微型和立交中心数据内得到公平对待。 这一选择可能会对PASTIS内部的模型性能产生影响,因为其时间跨度超过一年,而且其起始日期与日历年的开始不一致。 我们在第4.1节报告的发展研究中试验评估这一潜在性能因素的影响。 在所有其他实验中,我们使用DSRD编码来更好地规范PASTIS和MTLCC(涵盖2016日历年)之间的时间跨度。 对于比较模型,我们使用最初执行中选择的编码方法.

blocks.en: 3.7 Comparative Models
blocks.zh: 3.7 比较模型

blocks.en: We select the two SOTA models UTAE ( Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021 ) and TSViT ( Tarasiou et al., 2023 ) for comparison. To the best of our knowledge these two models are the closest in terms of architecture and previously used datasets to this work and thus are most suitable for a comparative study. Although both models have seen use on both of our chosen MTLCC and PASTIS datasets, a search indicates that the two models have only ever been used on different tile size variants for PASTIS, and neither have been used on the 48 ​ p ​ x 48px tile size variant of MTLCC. The architectures of these two models are described in section 2.3 , with TSViT acting as a comparison for ViT-based models which require spatial patching of tile data, and UTAE as a spatially convolutional model that only uses attention mechanisms for temporal aspects.
blocks.zh: 我们选择两种SOTA模型UTAE(Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021)和TSViT(Tarasiou等人, 2023)进行比较. 就我们所知,这两个模型在结构和以前使用的数据集方面最接近这项工作,因此最适合进行比较研究。 虽然这两个模型都曾在我们所选择的MTLCC和PASTIS数据集中使用过,但一次搜索表明,这两个模型仅用于PASTIS的不同瓦片尺寸变体,也没有用于MTLCC的48px48px瓦片尺寸变体上. 这两款模型的架构在第2.3节中描述,TSViT作为基于ViT的模型的比较,这些模型需要对瓦片数据进行空间补丁,而UTAE则作为空间演化模型,只使用注意力机制处理时间方面.

blocks.en: There are results for TSViT on MTLCC’s 24 × 24 24\times 24 pixel tile size variant with the 2016 data, but only with the fold index 0 instead of an average across the provided 10 folds, and the results were reported only for the validation set rather than the provided test set. In the case of PASTIS, due to restrictions of available hardware, the 24 × 24 24\times 24 tile size variant was introduced alongside TSViT. All 5 official PASTIS folds were then used and results were reported for the test sets. Across both datasets, TSViT reports results for a patch size of 2 × 2 2\times 2 pixels.
blocks.zh: TSViT对MTLCC的24×24 24\时24像素瓦片大小变体有结果,有2016年数据,但只有折叠指数0而不是所提供10折的平均值,结果只报告为验证集,而不是所提供的测试集. 在PASTIS的情况下,由于现有硬件的限制,24×24 24\times 24瓦大小变体与TSViT一起被引入. 然后使用了全部5个正式的PATIS折叠,并报告了测试结果。 在两个数据集中,TSViT报告的结果是补丁大小为2×2 2\times 2像素.

blocks.en: On the other hand, UTAE was published alongside the PASTIS dataset, and so has prior use on the original 128 × 128 128\times 128 pixel tile size variant, with all 5 official folds used and the test set mean results reported. UTAE does not report results for MTLCC in the original publication, but does have prior use on the same MTLCC 24 × 24 24\times 24 pixel tile size variant and conditions as TSViT through part of TSViT’s comparative model study. In contrast, it appears that UTAE and other comparison models in that study remained on the 128 × 128 128\times 128 pixel PASTIS tiles instead of the 24 × 24 24\times 24 pixel variant. We therefore believe our study is the first to compare our chosen models in the same conditions across all 4 dataset variants.
blocks.zh: 另一方面,UTAE与PASTIS数据集同时发布,在最初的128×128128\times128像素瓦片尺寸变体上也曾使用过,全部使用了5个官式折叠,并报告了测试集的平均结果. UTAE没有在原出版物中报告MTLCC的结果,但通过TSViT比较模型研究的一部分,在与TSViT相同的MTLCC 24×24 24\times 24像素瓦片大小变体和条件上确实有前期用途. 相比之下,该研究中的UTAE和其他比较模型似乎仍保留在128×128128\times128像素PATIS瓷砖上,而不是24×2424\times24像素变体上. 因此,我们认为,我们的研究是第一个在所有4个数据集变体中以相同条件比较我们所选择的模型。

blocks.en: The UTAE and TSViT authors comprehensively rule out other architectures as SOTA competitors ( Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021 ; Tarasiou et al., 2023 ) , therefore we do not include additional past models in our main comparison against the two most successful current methods. We do include UNet3D ( Rustowicz et al., 2019 ) as a baseline convolutional model with neither attention mechanisms or use of temporal band-date metadata, which our model and the other comparisons all use. All comparison models are run with their original hyperparameters within our PyTorch training, validation, and test framework (Section 3.9 ).
blocks.zh: UTAE和TSViT的作者全面排除了其他建筑作为SOTA竞争对手(Fare Garnot和Landrieu,2021年;Tarasiou等人,2023年),因此,与目前两种最成功的方法相比,我们的主比较中不包括额外的过去模型. 我们确实将UNet3D(Rustowicz等人,2019年)作为基线演化模型,既没有注意机制,也没有使用时间带-日期元数据,我们的模型和其他比较都使用了这些元数据。 所有比较模型都在我们的PyTorch训练、验证和测试框架内用原来的超参数运行(第3.9节)。

blocks.en: 3.8 Segmentation Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.8 分块计量

blocks.en: In our experiments, we calculate the micro Overall Accuracy (OA%) and the macro mean Intersection over Union (mIoU). OA% provides a measure of the total number of correct versus incorrect pixels across the results, while mIoU gives a class-averaged measure of the overlap between ground truth and predicted label masks. Between the two, mIoU is the preferred metric for true segmentation performance, because it is sensitive to both strong or poor performance on minority classes that may be obscured by the pixel-wise (OA%) accuracy metric ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . Furthermore, as we have imbalanced data, micro-averaging of OA% will lead to large classes such as backgrounds or meadows giving an overweight contribution to results ( Kocak et al., 2025 ) . Despite these issues, we retain it for direct comparability with other studies on our datasets ( Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021 ; Tarasiou et al., 2023 ; Rußwurm and Körner, 2018 ) . In our main results we also report the Dice Similarity Coefficient (known as F1 Score), which is the harmonic mean of precision and recall, to broaden the set of measures for future comparisons and provide an additional view of model performance under large variations in parcel size and class balance ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Kocak et al., 2025 ) . Although often used, we do not report the Kappa statistic ( McHugh, 2012 ) , as it is not comparable across datasets with different numbers of classes ( Müller et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们计算了微观整体精确度(OA%)和宏平均值跨联盟(mIoU). OA%提供了整个结果中正确与不正确的像素总量的测量,而mIoU给出了地面真理与预测的标签面具重叠的分类平均测量. 在二者之间,mIoU是真正分化性能的首选衡量标准,因为它对少数群体阶层的强效或差效都敏感,可能为像素-度(OA%)精确度衡量标准(Wang等人,2023年)所掩盖. 此外,由于我们的数据不平衡,OA%的微缩演算会导致背景或草地等大类对结果的贡献过重(Kocak等人,2025年)。 尽管存在这些问题,我们仍保留它,以便与关于我们数据集的其他研究(Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021年;Tarasiou等人, 2023年;Rußwurm and Körner, 2018年)直接进行比较。 在主要结果中,我们还报告了Dice相似性系数(称为F1 Score),这是精确和召回的谐音表示,目的是扩大今后比较的一套衡量标准,并在包裹大小和类别平衡的较大差异下,提供模型性能的额外观点(Wang等人,2026年;Kocak等人,2025年)。 尽管我们经常使用,但我们并不报告Kappa统计(McHugh,2012年),因为它在分类不同的数据集之间并不具有可比性(Müller等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: None of these metrics explicitly provide a measure of inter-class boundaries, which we believe to be crucial for SITS crop segmentation, as agricultural parcels often share boundaries but differ in the crops grown on either side ( North et al., 2019 ) . A model may accurately predict the crop within a parcel but still leak those predictions into background pixels or neighbouring parcels. A boundary quality metric would measure true model performances in this problem space. Therefore, we selected Boundary IoU ( Cheng et al., 2021 ) to improve our analysis. The authors believe this is the first use of Boundary IoU (Equation 1 ) in SITS crop segmentation.
blocks.zh: 这些衡量标准中没有一个明确提供阶级间界限的衡量标准,我们认为这对SITS作物分化至关重要,因为农业地块往往有共同的界限,但种植的作物在两边都有所不同(North等人,2019年)。 一个模型可以准确地预测一个包裹内的作物,但仍将这些预测泄露到背景像素或相邻的包裹中. 边界质量衡量标准将衡量这一问题空间中真正的模型性能。 因此,我们选择了边界IoU(Cheng等人,2021年)来改进我们的分析。 作者认为这是在SITS作物分割中首次使用边界IoU(方程式1).

We then adapt this for a multi-class setting with mean Boundary IoU (mBIoU) as shown in Equation 2 . mBIoU = 1 C ​ ∑ c = 1 C | ( G d c ∩ G c ) ∩ ( P d c ∩ P c ) | | ( G d c ∩ G c ) ∪ ( P d c ∩ P c ) | , \displaystyle\operatorname{mBIoU}=\frac{1}{C}\sum_{c=1}^{C}\frac{|(G^{c}_{d}\cap G^{c})\cap(P^{c}_{d}\cap P^{c})|}{|(G^{c}_{d}\cap G^{c})\cup(P^{c}_{d}\cap P^{c})|}, (2) where c c is a single crop class and C C is the set of all crop classes that appear in either the label or predicted classes of a tile. In this work, d d is set to 0.05 0.05 , i.e., 5% of the tile’s diagonal, rounded to the nearest pixel. This follows the recommendation of the metric’s authors, and corresponds to 2 2 pixels for a 24 × 24 24\times 24 pixel tile, 3 3 pixels for a 48 × 48 48\times 48 , and 9 9 pixels for a 128 × 128 128\times 128 pixel tile. Consequently, mBIoU scores are not directly comparable across different tile sizes (as discussed further in section 5.2 ).

blocks.en: 3.9 Training and Experimental Setup

blocks.en: We used the Adam optimiser ( Kingma and Ba, 2014 ) with a weight decay of 1.0 ​ e − 03 1.0e-03 . Models would train for up to 150 epochs, with early stopping allowed after epoch 100 if 20 epochs had been observed with a decline in results from the current best epoch.A learning rate of 5.0e-03 was used, with a cosine annealing scheduler ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) using 10 warm-up epochs and decaying the learning rate to 2.5e-06 by epoch 150. No warm restarts were used, and a dropout of 0.1 was applied. All models used a batch size of 4, since larger dataset variants could not be trained with higher batch sizes and changing batch sizes would introduce variance and bias.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 Adam Opimiser (Kingma and Ba, 2014) , 重量衰变为 1.0 e - 03 1.0e-03 。 模型将训练多达150个纪元,如果观测到20个纪元,加上目前最佳纪元的结果下降,则在100纪元之后可以提前停止。 使用5.0e-03的学习速率,使用共心厌食排程器(Loshchilov和Hutter,2017年)使用10个热身纪元,到150岁时,学习速率衰减到2.5e-06. 没有使用温暖的重启,并适用了0.1的退出。 所有模型都使用了4个批量尺寸,因为较大的数据集变体无法用更高的批量尺寸来训练,而改变的批量尺寸将带来差异和偏差.

blocks.en: We used standard cross entropy loss, applying masking only to the ‘Void’ parcel class of the PASTIS dataset discussed in section 3.1 . All other background pixels were retained for this study, as the ability of models to both discriminate crop-to-crop and crop-versus-non-crop is equally important. This also highlighted the value of including Boundary IoU as an evaluation metric, since a masked background class would remove many of the parcel borders.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了标准的横跨 en损耗,仅将遮盖应用到PASTIS数据集中的 " void " 类 3.1 (韩语). 所有其他背景像素都被保留在这项研究中,因为模型对作物对作物和作物对非作物进行区分的能力同样重要。 这也突显了将边界IoU作为评价指标的价值,因为蒙面背景类将清除许多包裹边界。

blocks.en: Models were trained on three environments: a desktop with an Nvidia RTX 4080 GPU and Intel i9-13900K CPU, a server with an Nvidia RTX A6000 GPU and Intel i9-14900K CPU, and Nvidia A100 nodes on the Supercomputing Wales HPC service ( Supercomputing Wales ). blocks.en: We first present the architectural ablation study performed for the design of our PAtteRNS model. The first comparison, shown in Table 2 , examines the architectural design of the PAtteRNS model: the inclusion of each dimensional transformer, the fuse block style used to merge parallel spectral and temporal transformers, and whether a convolutional refinement head is used.
blocks.zh: 我们首先介绍了为设计我们的PattERNS模型而进行的建筑装饰研究。 表2所示的首个比较考察了PattERNS模型的建筑设计:包含每个维变压器,用于合并平行光谱和时间变压器的引信块样式,以及是否使用一个演化完善头.

blocks.en: Across both datasets, the full complement of temporal, spectral, and spatial transformers together performs best, with temporal attention shown to play the most important single role in the overall performance. We decide to use Spectral Queries Temporal cross-attention in our full model, as this directional attention showed clear dominance over the Temporal Queries Spectral cross-attention, while also producing especially good performance on PASTIS-128. While Bi-Directional cross-attention also produces strong results on MTLCC-48, we note that performance is not vastly greater than with no cross-attention, and likewise appears to negatively impact performance on PASTIS-128. The more neutral effect of Spectral Queries Temporal compared to Bi-Directional or no cross-attention on MTLCC-48 may indicate that the spectral and temporal patterns contribute more equally on this dataset, while in PASTIS-128 the temporal patterns take a majority share compared to its spectral information. This would be backed up by PASTIS-128 having both longer temporal sequences and fewer spectral bands compared to MTLCC-48. We include all fuse block types in our published model to suit any future use on other datasets that may react differently to ours.
blocks.zh: 在两个数据集中,时间、光谱和空间变压器的完整配对作用最强,同时显示时间注意在整体性能中发挥最重要的单一作用。 我们决定在我们的完整模型中使用Spectric Queries Temperal cross-attention,因为这种方向性关注显示出了对Temperal Queries Spectory content-attention的明显支配,同时也在PASTIS-128上产生特别良好的性能. 虽然双直接交叉意向在MTLCC-48上也产生很大效果,但我们注意到,性能并不比无交叉意向大得多,而且似乎也对PASTIS-128的性能产生不利影响。 相较于MTLCC-48上的双直径或无横切,光谱质询时态的更中性效应可能表明,光谱和时态模式对这一数据集的贡献更为平等,而在PASTIS-128中,时态模式与其光谱信息相比占多数。 与MTLCC-48相比,PASTIS-128具有较长的时间序列和较少的光谱带,以此为后盾。 我们在公布的模型中包括所有引信区块类型,以适应今后在可能对我们的数据集作出不同反应的其他数据集上的任何用途。

blocks.en: Upon introducing the CRH to models with a parallel temporal and spectral transformer, but without a spatial transformer, a mean improvement of + + 0.8 OA%, 4.1% in mIoU, and 13.5% in mBIoU is observed, marking a very significant impact. When introducing the CRH to the models with all transformers, there is a mean improvement of + + 0.5 OA%, 1.9% in mIoU and 2.7% in mBIoU, demonstrating its wide applicability as well as a remaining advantage in spatial representational capacity over attention mechanisms. Notably, the inclusion of the spatial transformer still brings performance improvements in comparison to the temporal and spectral transformers operating solely as a parallel pair, showing that the CRH is best included as a complement to the spatial transformer, not as a full replacement. This is illustrated by the 13.3% mBIoU increase for MTLCC-48 and 15.3% for PASTIS-128 when adding the spatial transformer to the temporal and spectral transformers.
blocks.zh: 在将CRH引入具有平行时间和光谱变压器的模型,但没有空间变压器时,观测到++0.8 OA%,mIOU4.1%,mBIOU13.5%的均匀改进,标志着非常显著的影响. 在将CRH引入所有变压器的型号时,有++0.5 OA%,mIoU1.9%和mBIoU2.7%的中度改进,表明其广泛适用性以及空间代表能力相对于注意机制的剩余优势. 值得注意的是,空间变压器的列入与仅作为平行对子运行的时空变压器和光谱变压器相比,仍然带来性能的改进,表明CRH最好作为空间变压器的补充而列入,而不是作为完全的替换. MTLCC-48的mBIoU增加13.3%,PATIS-128在将空间变压器加入时间和光谱变压器时增加15.3%。

blocks.en: The inclusion of the spectral transformer generally improves segmentation performance, although the magnitude of the improvement is relatively modest. Comparing the best-performing configurations, MTLCC-48 improves from 92.0% to 92.1% OA, from 0.772 to 0.774 mIoU, and from 0.533 to 0.537 mBIoU when the spectral transformer is included. A similar trend is observed for PASTIS-128, where OA increases from 83.0% to 83.3% and mIoU from 0.643 to 0.649, while mBIoU decreases slightly from 0.437 to 0.435. The strongest PASTIS performance is obtained when spectral-to-temporal cross-attention is used, suggesting that interaction between spectral and temporal representations can further enhance the benefit of spectral modelling. Overall, these results indicate that the spectral transformer provides some additional discriminative information in both datasets, particularly for overall and region-level segmentation performance, although its contribution is smaller than that of the temporal transformer.
blocks.zh: 加入光谱变压器一般会提高分解性能,虽然改进的幅度相对较小. 相比性能最好的配置,MTLCC-48的OA从92.0%提高到92.1%,光谱变压器从0.772提高到0.774 mIoU,光谱变压器从0.533提高到0.537 mBIoU. PATIS-128也有类似趋势,OA从83.0%增至83.3%,mIoU从0.643增至0.649,mBIoU则从0.437略降至0.435。 在使用光谱对时空的交叉注意时获得最强的PASTIS性能,这表明光谱和时空表示之间的相互作用可以进一步提高光谱建模的效益. 总体而言,这些结果表明,光谱变压器在两个数据集中都提供了一些额外的歧视性信息,尤其是对于整体和区域一级的分解性能,尽管其作用小于时间变压器.

blocks.en: Our next ablation examines several adjustable hyperparameters in our model. We also report inference time and parameter count, since all three hyperparameters trade off representational capacity against computational cost. The goal is to reduce model complexity where larger hyperparameters do not improve performance, while identifying those that do and evaluating them individually against their cost. The results of this experiment (Table 3 ) relate to a baseline model of all three transformers, a simple concatenation fuse block, and the inclusion of the CRH.

blocks.en: Most notably, reducing the patch size p p significantly improved boundary reasoning, increasing mBIoU by 5.7% when using p = 2 p=2 instead of p = 4 p=4 . However, other metrics showed little variation, while inference time and model size increased significantly. We therefore consider patch sizes p = 2 p=2 and p = 4 p=4 separately for the relevant models. The size of the c ​ l ​ s cls token representation and the embedded dimension size d d both showed low variance in performance metrics. Increasing the embedding size from 128 to 256 more than triples model parameters and roughly doubles inference time. These costs were considered too high for the small performance gain, so we kept d = 128 d=128 for the full model. For the c ​ l ​ s cls token, the added inference time and parameters are marginal, so we keep its representation size at k k for comparability with TSViT.

blocks.en: Our ablation study also examined two more factors, the explicit masking of temporally padded values in attention, and the choice of date encoding method. Table 4 reports these results. In the case of date encoding methods, switching between DOY and DSRD encodings had no notable effect on either dataset. This is unsurprising for MTLCC, whose first capture date lies near the start of the year, but PASTIS spans September 2018 to October 2019 and was expected to be more sensitive; nonetheless, we observed little variation. Given this inconclusive evidence, we adopt DSRD encoding and explicit pad-value masking in the final model to standardise potential inter-dataset differences in temporal window position and completeness. The factor of masking padded temporal bands in attention similarly produced minimal change, suggesting the architecture can largely self-regulate attention to static, unique pad values. We still retain explicit masking of padded tokens in the experiments of section 4.2 to avoid any unforeseen variance due to these pad values.
blocks.zh: 我们还研究了另外两个因素:在注意力中明确掩盖时间上的加值,以及选择日期编码方法。 表4报告了这些结果。 在日期编码方法方面,DOY和DSRD编码之间的切换对两个数据集都没有显著影响. 这对MTLCC来说并不奇怪,它的第一个捕捉日期接近年初,但PASTIS跨度为2018年9月至2019年10月,预计会更加敏感;然而,我们观察到的变异很小. 鉴于这些没有定论的证据,我们在最后模型中采用了DSRD编码和明确的垫值掩码,以规范时间窗口位置和完整性方面潜在的数据集间差异。 在注意力中遮盖时间段的因素同样产生了最小的变化,表明该架构基本上可以自我调节对静态,独特的垫值的注意. 我们仍然保留在第4.2节实验中明确掩盖加价符,以避免由于这些垫值而出现任何意外差异。

Using p = 2 p=2 , PAtteRNS holds the highest values for mIoU, Dice, and mBIoU for both datasets by a considerable margin, while UTAE marginally leads in terms of OA%. Over this metric, these two models notably stand above UNet3D and TSViT. Overall, the results on the MTLCC variants are significantly higher than those achieved on PASTIS.
blocks.zh: 表5显示PattERNS. UNet3D的SOTA结果,如预期,在所有情况中,其他三种模型都表现不佳。 使用p=2 p=2,PattERNS对mIoU,Dice和mBIoU两个数据集的数值最高,差幅相当大,而UTAE在OA%方面略微领先. 通过这一衡量标准,这两个模型明显高于UNet3D和TSViT。 总体而言,MTLCC变式的结果大大高于PASTIS的结果。

blocks.en: For both ViT-based models, TSViT and PAtteRNS, we generally observe improvements across all metrics when reducing patch size from p = 4 p=4 to p = 2 p=2 , in agreement with our initial ablation experiments. This effect is strongest for mBIoU, with average improvements of 8.1% on MTLCC and 8.2% on PASTIS-24. However, on PASTIS-128 the TSViT experiment was infeasible due to computational limits, and PAtteRNS showed small decreases in mIoU, Dice, and mBIoU. PAtteRNS largely beats comparison models in mBIoU, as illustrated in Figure 6 and further confirmed by additional results in C .
blocks.zh: 对于基于ViT的模型TSViT和PatteRNS,我们一般在将补丁大小从p=4p=4减少到p=2p=2时,观察到所有度量衡的改进,这与我们的初始衰减实验一致. 这种效应对mBIoU最强,对MTLCC的平均改进率为8.1%,对PASTIS-24的平均改进率为8.2%。 然而,在PASTIS-128上,由于计算极限,TSViT实验不可行,PatteRNS显示mIoU,Dice和mBIoU略有下降. PattERNS基本上比mBIoU的比较模型要好,如图6所示,C的其他结果进一步证实了这一点。

blocks.en: Figure 6: An illustration of PAtteRNS’ segmentation capabilities against comparison models. Our model is shown here to combine precise boundaries with full recall of present classes in the ground truth labels of a tile from MTLCC-48.
blocks.zh: 图6:对照比较模型说明PattERNS的分解能力。 我们的模型将精确的界限与完全召回MTLCC-48的一块瓷砖的地面真象标签中的目前等级结合起来。

blocks.en: Comparing the larger and smaller tile-size variants within each dataset, OA% is seen to consistently decrease from MTLCC-48 to MTLCC-24 across all models by similar margins, but remains similar from PASTIS-128 to PASTIS-24. In contrast, mIoU and Dice largely improve across both datasets on the smaller tile-size variants, with UNet3D showing particular benefit in its mIoU and Dice increasing by 4.6% and 3.4% respectively from MTLCC-48 to MTLCC-24, and 2.3% and 1.8% respectively from PASTIS-128 to PASTIS-24. PAtteRNS also shows an increase of 1.9% and 1.4% respectively in mIoU and Dice from MTLCC-48 to MTLCC-24, and 2.0% and 1.4% respectively from PASTIS-128 to PASTIS-24. There are some standout performance decreases from decreasing tile size, with UTAE showing a decline across all three of OA%, mIoU, and Dice on PASITS, whilst the same model retains the usual OA% decrease and mIoU/Dice increase on MTLCC.
blocks.zh: 将每个数据集中大小大小的瓦片变体相比较,OA%被看成在所有模型中,从MTLCC-48持续下降至MTLCC-24,幅度相近,但从PASTIS-128到PASTIS-24仍然相似。 相比之下,mIoU和Dice在小瓷砖大小的变体上两个数据集都大有改善,UNet3D在mIoU和Dice中显示出特别的好处,分别从MTLCC-48到MTLCC-24增加了4.6%和3.4%,从PASTIS-128到PASTIS-24分别增加了2.3%和1.8%。 PATTERNS还显示mIoU和Dice分别从MTLCC-48增长到MTLCC-24,以及从PATIS-128增长到PATIS-24分别增长2.0%和1.4%。 由于瓦片尺寸的不断减少,一些突出的性能有所降低,UTAE在PASITS上的OA%、mIoU和Dice三个方面都显示出下降,而同一模型在MTLCC上保留了通常的OA%的下降和mIoU/Dice的上升.

blocks.en: Table 6 shows that, as expected, our PAtteRNS model increases the parameter count relative to other models by adding a third factorised self-attention block for the spectral dimension. However, this increase is not mirrored in the required multiply-accumulate operations (MACs), and PAtteRNS achieves both competitive inference times and the fastest mean epoch duration during training at a patch size of p = 4 p=4 . With a patch size of p = 2 p=2 , PAtteRNS still has faster inference and mean epoch durations than TSViT at p = 2 p=2 , but is slower than UTAE, which does not use a patch-based vision transformer architecture.
blocks.zh: 表6显示,如预期,我们的PattERNS模型通过在光谱维度上增加第三个因子化自留区块来提高参数数相对于其他模型. 然而,这种增加并没有反映在所需的乘积操作(MAC)中,而PatteRNS既实现了竞争的推断时间,也实现了训练期间最快的平均时长,补丁大小为p=4p=4. 补丁大小为p = 2 p = 2,PatteRNS在p = 2 p = 2时仍然有比 TSViT更快的推论和平均时长,但比UTAE慢,它不使用基于补丁的视变器架构.

blocks.en: Both UTAE and PAtteRNS with p = 4 p=4 have much higher mean best epochs, approaching the 150-epoch limit, suggesting potential performance gains with more epochs, which could not be tested within this study’s time constraints. Table 6 also shows the cost of reducing patch size from p = 4 p=4 to p = 2 p=2 for TSViT and PAtteRNS in almost all respects. The only clear benefit is a drop in PAtteRNS’s mean best epoch from 140.3 ( p = 4 p=4 ) to 87.7 ( p = 2 p=2 ), slightly offsetting the longer per-epoch training time. For TSViT, however, the mean best epoch increases from 69.7 to 90.0 under the same change, worsening the impact of longer epoch durations.
blocks.zh: 使用p=4的UTAE和PattERNS都有更高的平均最佳时代,接近150个时代的极限,表明在更多时代的潜在性能增益,无法在本研究的时间限制内测试。 表6还显示在几乎所有方面将TSViT和PatteRNS的补丁尺寸从p=4 p=4减少到p=2 p=2的费用。 唯一的明显好处是PattERNS的平均最佳时代从140.3(p = 4 p = 4)下降到87.7(p = 2 p = 2),略微抵消了每个时代较长的训练时间. 然而,对TSViT来说,在同一变化下,平均最佳时代从69.7年增加到90.0年,加剧了更长时间的时代的影响。

blocks.en: Table 6: Model Computational Performance Comparison. Model trainable parameters, MACs of the forward pass, mean inference time, and mean training time are reported. All reported results are for 3 seeded repeats using MTLCC 48’s first fold, with inference time reporting the mean time per batch of 4 samples over the test, mean epoch duration reporting the average combined train and validation duration per epoch using our training setup, and best epoch measured as the average index of the best test set mIoU out of 150 maximum epochs from training. MACs are reported for the dimensions of MTLCC 48.
