blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Figure 7: Mean Boundary IoU (mBIoU) achieved by each model across all four dataset and tile-size combinations. PAtteRNS with p = 2 p=2 achieves the leading result in three of the four combinations, with PAtteRNS at p = 4 p=4 leading marginally on PASTIS-128 (see Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 图7:每个模型在所有四个数据集和瓷砖大小组合中实现的平均边界IoU(mBIoU). PATERNS,p=2 p=2 实现了四个组合中的三个组合的领先结果,PATERNS在PATIS-128上领先4 p=4(见表5)。

blocks.en: Overall, we achieve the strongest results on nearly all metrics and dataset variants, with the only exception being OA%, where UTAE leads by at most 0.6% (mean lead 0.3%). Despite this, when considering each model’s strongest configuration per dataset, an analysis of our model against UTAE still indicates a broader advantage for PAtteRNS. On MTLCC, both models see their best results on MTLCC-24, with PAtteRNS at p = 2 p=2 leading UTAE by 1.4% in mIoU, 0.9% in Dice, and 6.3% in mBIoU, while trailing by -0.2 in OA%. On PASTIS, UTAE’s best results are reported for PASTIS-128, while PAtteRNS’s best is achieved with p = 2 p=2 on PASTIS-24. Here, the OA% gap narrows to just 0.1 percentage points, while PAtteRNS retains a lead of 1.4% in mIoU and 0.8% in Dice. As these two configurations differ in tile size, mBIoU cannot be directly compared between them (see section 3.8 ), however, for UTAE’s strongest configuration on PASITS-128, PAtteRNS at p = 2 p=2 still leads in mBIoU by 2.1%, with the same comparison on PASTIS-24 raising to a 15.5% lead. This evidences that under fair comparison, PAtteRNS matches or exceeds UTAE on every metric where a valid comparison can be made.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们在几乎所有的度量衡和数据集变体上都取得了最强的结果,唯一的例外是OA%,其中UTAE领先最高为0.6%(平均为0.3%). 尽管如此,在考虑每个模型的每个数据集最强的配置时,对我们的模型对UTAE的分析仍然表明PatteRNS具有更广泛的优势. 在MTLCC上,两种型号在MTLCC-24上都看到其最佳结果,PattERNS在p=2p=2领先的UTAE在mIoU上比1.4%,Dice上比0.9%,mBIoU上比6.3%,而OA上比0.2%落后. 在PASTIS上,UTAE的最佳结果为PASTIS-128,而PatternS的最佳结果则是P=2 p=2的PASTIS-24。 在此,OA%差距缩小到只有0.1个百分点,而PattERNS在mIoU中保留了1.4%的铅,在Dice中保留了0.8%的铅. 由于这两个构型在瓦片尺寸上不同,mBIoU无法直接加以比较(见第3.8节),然而对于UTAE在PASITS-128上最强的构型,PattERNS在p=2p=2时仍然领先于mBIoU2.1%,与PATIS-24的对比相同,升至15.5%的铅. 这证明,在公平比较的情况下,PattERNS在每一个可进行有效比较的度量标准上都符合或超过UTAE。

blocks.en: This conclusion is further supported by the per-class behaviour influencing each model’s overall performance in their best configurations ( D ). On MTLCC-24, PAtteRNS achieves a higher true positive rate than UTAE for 13 of 18 classes, while the performance of PAtteRNS at p = 2 p=2 on PASTIS-24 against UTAE on PASTIS-128 shows a lead again for PAtteRNS in 15 of 19 classes, with one class drawn. A further contributor to UTAE’s narrow OA% lead at each dataset’s best configuration is the Background class specifically, which represents a substantial share of all pixels in both MTLCC-24 (43.2%) and PASTIS-24 (44.7% of non-void pixels). UTAE achieves a higher true positive rate than PAtteRNS on this class in both cases, leading by 1.2 points on MTLCC-24 and 2.6 points on PASTIS-24. Weighted by class population, this single class contributes + + 0.52 and + + 1.16 percentage points to UTAE’s OA% lead on MTLCC-24 and PASTIS-24 respectively, both values exceeding the relevant OA% lead UTAE holds. These results indicate that UTAE’s marginal OA% advantage is concentrated in the disproportionately large background classes, rather than reflecting any broader advantage in segmentation performance for crop classes across the datasets as a whole.
blocks.zh: 这一结论还得到每个类别的行为的进一步支持,这些行为影响着每个模型在最佳配置(D.)方面的总体表现。 在MTLCC-24上,PattERNS在18个班次中的13个班次取得了比UTAE更高的真实正率,而PattERNS在PATIS-24对UTAE在PATIS-128上的性能显示PATERNS在19个班次中的15个班次中再次领先,抽出一个班次. UTAE在每套数据集最佳配置中的窄 OA % 领先率的另一个贡献者是背景类,这在MTLCC-24(43.2%)和PASTIS-24(无投影像素的44.7%)中都占了所有像素的很大一部分。 UTAE在本类中都取得了比PattERNS更高的真实正率,在MTLCC-24上领先1.2分,在PATIS-24上领先2.6分. 按类别人口计算,这一单一类别分别贡献++ 0.52和++ 1.16个百分点于意大利电信联盟在MTLCC-24和PATIS-24上的OA%铅,这两个数值都超过了相关的OA%铅UTAE持有量。 这些结果表明,空运联盟的边际OA%优势集中在不成比例的大型背景类,而不是反映整个数据集作物类在分化性能方面的任何更广泛的优势。

blocks.en: Table 6 shows that, with patch size p = 4 p=4 , our fully factorised temporal-spectral-spatial attention for SITS crop segmentation matches other SOTA models in both training and inference speed, achieving the shortest mean epoch time and inference within 0.1ms of TSViT and UTAE, implying all three saturate hardware data I/O limits. Our architecture also decouples the parameter cost of the additional factorised spectral self-attention block from its computational cost, increasing representational capacity without a proportional rise in computation.
blocks.zh: 表6显示,在补丁大小p=4p=4的情况下,我们用于SITS作物分化的全因子化的时间-光谱空间注意与培训和推论速度方面的其他SOTA模型相匹配,在TSViT和UTAE的0.1ms范围内实现最短的平均时间和推论,意味着所有三个饱和硬件数据I/O极限. 我们的架构还使额外的因子化光谱自留能区块的参数成本与其计算成本脱钩,增加代表能力,而不会在计算中按比例上升。

blocks.en: When reducing patch size from p = 4 p=4 to p = 2 p=2 , our model and TSViT generally improve across all metrics (see section 4.2 ), further increasing PAtteRNS’s lead over comparison models. However, TSViT still underperforms UTAE in all fields except mBIoU. An exception occurs for our model on PASTIS-128 at p = 2 p=2 , where mIoU, Dice, and mBIoU decrease slightly compared to p = 4 p=4 , unlike the improvements seen elsewhere. Because this patch–tile combination yields the longest token sequences in our study, this may indicate that the model’s depth and capacity for global self-attention are saturated. Confirming this and exploring whether larger hyperparameters could improve performance will require additional experiments beyond the scope of this work.
blocks.zh: 在将补丁大小从p = 4 p = 4 降为p = 2 p = 2 时,我们的模型和 TSViT 在所有度量衡上普遍改进(见第4.2节),进一步增加了PatteRNS的领先比比较模型. 然而,除mBIoU外,TSViT在所有领域仍然表现不佳的UTAE. 我们的PASTIS-128型号在p=2 p=2时出现例外,与P=4 p=4相比,mIoU,Dice和mBIoU略有下降,与其他地方看到的改进不同. 由于这种补丁-瓦片组合产生我们研究中最长的符号序列,这可能表明模型的深度和全球自觉能力是饱和的。 要确认这一点,并探讨较大的超参数是否能够提高性能,就需要在这项工作范围之外进行更多的实验。

blocks.en: For mBIoU, PAtteRNS leads the next-best model by an average of 4.4% at p = 2 p=2 (both datasets). At p = 4 p=4 , it is 2.5% behind UTAE on both MTLCC variants but still leads by 2.0% on average across both PASTIS variants. Considerations in section 4.1 suggest that retaining the CRH alongside the spatial encoder transformer contributes to this, as their combination enhances fine boundary delineation. The performance in mBIoU of all models is shown across the four dataset tile-size variants in Figure 7 , highlighting the lead PAtteRNS holds across all combinations.
blocks.zh: 对于mBIoU,PattERNS在p=2 p=2(两个数据集)时平均领先4.4%的次佳模型. 在p = 4 p = 4 时,在MTLCC两个变体上均比UTAE低2.5%,但在PASTIS两个变体上仍平均领先2.0%. 第4.1节中的考虑表明,在空间编码器变压器旁边保留CRH有助于做到这一点,因为两者的结合会加强精细的边界划定。 所有模型的mBIoU性能在图7的四个数据集瓦片大小的变体中显示,突出显示领先的PattERNS在所有组合中持有.

blocks.en: 5.1 Comparison Model Performances
blocks.zh: 5.1 比较模型性能

blocks.en: Our results in Table 5 differ from those in the works introducing both UTAE ( Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021 ) and TSViT ( Tarasiou et al., 2023 ) . For UTAE, higher performance is achieved in this work than the results reported in the original study using the PASTIS-128 dataset, with OA% increasing from 83.2% to 83.8%, and mIoU increasing from 0.631 0.631 to 0.650 0.650 . We believe the most likely source of this improvement is the larger number of epochs in our training regime, with the original work only using 100 epochs compared to our 150. This is evidenced in Table 6 , where UTAE reaches its best-performance at a mean epoch of 135.7, close to the end of the additional 50-epoch training period used in our implementation. Further experiments lie beyond the scope of this study but may be worthwhile for both UTAE and PAtteRNS, which has a mean best epoch of 140.3, to assess performance over many more epochs. For TSViT, we observe the opposite trend: our experiments fail to reproduce the model’s originally reported performance on both MTLCC-24 and PASTIS-24. For MTLCC, this appears to be simply due to the original work masking the ‘Background’ class in the loss and metrics, which we do not mask, as discussed in Section 3.9 . For PASTIS, although the original paper appears to suggest that the ‘Background’ class was masked in a similar manner, our interpretation of the published implementation is that only the ‘Void’ class was excluded from the loss computation and evaluation metrics for PASTIS-24, which matches our implemented masking practice. We could not identify a specific cause for TSViT’s performance drop on PASTIS-24 compared to it’s original reported results, and whilst UTAE on PASTIS-24 shows a clear performance drop across all comparable metrics relative to PASTIS-128, it’s performance on PASTIS-24 in our work still surpasses what was reported as a comparison for TSViT’s introduction in that work. TSViT at p = 4 p=4 does improve slightly from PASTIS-24 to PASTIS-128, which makes us conclude that UTAE’s convolutional architecture may require more careful parameter tuning when moving away from its original tile size than the ViT-based TSViT. Based on our experiments, UTAE remains the stronger of these two models for crop segmentation.
blocks.zh: 表5中的结果与引进UTAE(Fare Garnot and Landrieu, 2021年)和TSViT(Tarasiou等人, 2023年)的工程不同。 对于UTAE来说,这项工作的绩效高于最初使用PATIS-128数据集进行的研究的结果,OA%从83.2%上升到83.8%,MIOU从0.631 0.631上升到0.650 0.650. 我们认为,这种改进的最可能来源是,我们的培训制度中更多的时代,最初的工作只使用100个时代,而我们的150个时代。 这一点在表6中得到证明,在表6中,空运联合企业在135.7的中世纪达到最佳业绩,接近我们实施过程中使用的额外50世纪培训期的结束。 进一步的实验超出了本研究的范围,但对于UTAE和PatteRNS来说都是值得的,因为PatteRNS的最佳时代是140.3,用来评估更多时代的绩效。 对于TSViT,我们观察到相反的趋势:我们的实验未能复制该模型在MTLCC-24和PATIS-24上最初报告的性能. 对于MTLCC来说,这似乎仅仅是因为最初的工作掩盖了损失和衡量标准中的`背景 ' 类,我们没有掩盖,正如第3.9节所讨论的那样。 对PASTIS来说,虽然原始文件似乎暗示`背景 ' 类以类似方式被掩盖,但我们对公布的执行的解释是,只有`Void ' 类被排除在PASTIS-24的损失计算和评价指标之外,这与我们已实施的掩盖做法相吻合。 与最初报告的结果相比,我们无法确定TSViT在PASTIS-24上的性能下降的具体原因,虽然UTAE在PASTIS-24上的性能明显下降,但相对于PASTIS-128,我们工作中PASTIS-24上的性能仍然超过TSViT在这项工作中引入的比较。 TSViT at p = 4 p=4确实从PASTIS-24到PASTIS-128略有改进,这使我们得出结论,UTAE的进化结构在脱离其原有的瓦片尺寸时可能需要比基于ViT的TSViT更小心的参数调和. 根据我们的实验,UTAE仍然是这两种作物分化模型中最强的.

blocks.en: 5.2 Boundary IoU
blocks.zh: 5.2 边界线

blocks.en: Boundary IoU is a useful measure of boundary quality in segmentation results, capturing performance aspects that traditional metrics under-represent. Its main weakness is reliance on a fixed pixel width for the ‘boundary’ region, which makes mBIoU scores incomparable across different tile-size variants, even on the same dataset. Future work could increase the relevance of Boundary IoU for cropland segmentation by defining boundary width in real-world spatial units rather than pixels. Because all SITS data sources have known spatial resolutions, often at standard sizes like 10 m/pixel, this would enable a more scientifically grounded notion of accurate boundary placement and support broader, more consistent adoption of the metric across datasets.
blocks.zh: 边界IoU是分界结果中边界质量的有用衡量标准,它捕捉了传统衡量标准不足的性能方面。 它的主要弱点是依赖一个固定的像素宽度来表示 " 边界 " 区域,这使得mBIoU的得分在不同的瓦片大小的变体之间是不可比较的,即使是在同一数据集上。 今后的工作可以通过以现实世界空间单位而不是像素界定边界宽度,提高边界IoU对耕地分割的相关性。 由于所有SITS数据来源都掌握了空间分辨率,通常在标准大小如10 m/像素上,因此,这将使精确边界定位的概念具有更科学的依据,并支持更广泛、更一致地采用跨数据集的计量。

blocks.en: 5.3 Class-wise Performance Across Datasets
blocks.zh: 5.3 各数据集的类性能

blocks.en: As posed in sections 2.4 and 3.1 , our experiments test whether varying class groupings in crop segmentation datasets reduce reported model performance. We found that the PASTIS-128 dataset’s parcels were 60% non-homogenous in ground coverage, equating to 25.2% of the pixels in the dataset, while MTLCC-48 sees only 24% of its parcels featuring classes with non-homogenous ground coverage, comprising of only ‘Meadow’ in this case, measuring in at 14.1% of dataset pixels. Additionally, four PASTIS classes were considered taxonomical aggregates: ‘Fruits, Vegetables, & Flowers‘, ‘Leguminous Fodder‘, ‘Orchard‘, and ‘Mixed Cereal‘. These were expected to perform poorly in between-class confusion because they lack a single phenological identity and may biologically overlap with other classes. In MTLCC, ‘Winter Wheat’ was found as a taxonomical aggregate of soft and hard winter wheats, and ‘Rapeseed’ as a seasonal aggregate of its own seasonal varieties, although these classes are both potentially less damaging to between-class confusion than the aggregates found in PASTIS. Beyond the large advantage MTLCC shows over PASTIS for all models and metrics in Table 5 , our analysis ( B ) indicates that PASTIS’s avoidable taxonomical aggregate classes, and the taxonomically correct but non-homogenous classes in both datasets substantially reduce model performance.
blocks.zh: 如第2.4节和第3.1节所述,我们的实验测试作物分块数据集中的不同类别是否降低了所报告的模型性能。 我们发现PASTIS-128数据集的包裹在地面覆盖中是60%的非同质的,相当于数据集中25.2%的像素,而MTLCC-48只看到其包含非同质地面覆盖类的24 % 的包裹,这里只包含"Meadow",以数据集像素的14.1%测量. 此外,四个PASTIS类被视为分类汇总:`裂缝、蔬菜、花卉'、`Leguminous Fodder'、`Orchard'和`混合谷物'。 由于缺乏单一的苯学特征,而且可能在生物学上与其他类相重叠,因此预计这些类别之间的混淆表现不佳。 在MTLCC中, " Winter Wheat " 被认为是软和硬冬季小麦的分类集合, " Rapeseed " 是其本身季节性品种的季节性集合,尽管这些类别对不同类别之间混淆的破坏可能比PASTIS中的集合小。 除了MTLCC对表5中所有模型和指标的PASTIS显示的巨大优势外,我们的分析(B)表明,PASTIS的可避免分类综合类,以及两个数据集中的分类正确但非同质类大大降低了模型性能。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This study introduces our new model for SITS crop semantic segmentation, PAtteRNS, and shows our novel fully-factorised attention architecture to achieve SOTA results for this field. This performance advantage is achieved at similar computational cost to existing models at patch size p = 4 p=4 , with a greater margin obtained at p = 2 p=2 for a higher computational cost. Although this smaller patch size leads to slower training and inference than non-ViT-based models, our model still surpasses TSViT, the incumbent SOTA ViT-based model, for this patch size in speed and capability.
blocks.zh: 本研究介绍了我们关于STIS作物语义分解的新模式PattERNS,并展示了我们为在这一领域实现SOTA成果而打造的全要素关注架构。 这种性能优势是在补丁大小p = 4 p = 4 的计算成本与现有模型相似的情况下实现的,在p = 2 p = 2 的计算成本较高时获得较大差值. 虽然这种较小的补丁尺寸导致培训和推论比基于非ViT的模型慢,但我们的模型仍然超越了基于在任SOTA ViT的模型TSViT,因为这种补丁的大小在速度和能力上都是如此.

blocks.en: Our model exhibits particularly strong performance in parcel boundary delineation, demonstrated through the Boundary IoU metric, which we show to be a valuable criterion for the quantitative evaluation of crop segmentation models. Application of a convolutional refinement head to spatial transformer outputs was shown as a key part of this strength, demonstrating the continued benefit of convolutional components in contemporary transformer-heavy crop segmentation models.
blocks.zh: 我们的模式在包裹划界方面表现特别出色,通过边界IoU度量表显示了这一点。 我们显示,边界IoU度量表是对作物分块模式进行定量评价的宝贵标准。 对空间变压器输出物采用旋变精度头被显示为这种强度的关键部分,表明在当代变压器-重力作物分化模型中,旋变元件的持续好处.

blocks.en: We also find that crop segmentation models perform differently when trained and evaluated with SITS tiles of different pixel sizes, and therefore different tile sizes should not be used in fair comparison. While many models improve with smaller tile sizes, others loose significant capacity, especially if designed for larger tiles. Our findings here indicate substantial scope for future research on principled methods to determine the optimal tile size for models operating on any given dataset. Such methods could enable dynamic adjustment of tile dimensions during training, followed by reassembly of the tiles for inference and evaluation, and may ultimately yield performance gains for crop segmentation models. Our experiments suggest that smaller tile sizes may work to the advantage of models utilising global self-attention mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 我们还发现,在使用不同像素大小的SITS瓷砖进行训练和评价时,作物分块模型的性能不同,因此不应在公平比较时使用不同的瓦片大小. 虽然许多型号以较小的瓦片尺寸改进,但其他型号则松散了显著的容量,特别是如果为更大的瓦片设计. 我们在这里的研究结果表明,今后对原则方法进行研究有很大的余地,以确定在任何数据集上运行的模型的最佳瓦片尺寸。 这种方法可以在培训期间对瓦片尺寸进行动态调整,然后对瓦片进行重新组装,以便推论和评价,最终可产生作物分化模型的性能收益。 我们的实验表明,较小的瓦片可能有利于利用全球自觉机制的模型。

blocks.en: Finally, we provide evidence that taxonomical aggregate classes are a potential cause of poor crop segmentation performance across all studied models, and suggest that future datasets should work to minimise the number of taxonomical aggregations when constructing class sets from ground truth data sources. We also find that non-homogeneous taxonomic classes tend to lower reported performance, and models must improve at handling these valid and common classes. We could not confirm any effects of seasonal aggregate classes due to a low population of this aggregation type within our chosen datasets, however this should be taken into consideration for future investigation. Further research on true multi-year datasets is also needed to assess the importance of positional encoding methods for capture dates in deep temporal models.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们提供证据表明,分类汇总类是造成所有被研究模型的作物分化性能不佳的潜在原因,并建议今后的数据集在从地面真实数据来源构建分类集时,应尽量减少分类汇总的数量。 我们还发现,非同一分类学类往往会降低报告的表现,模型必须改进处理这些有效而常见的分类。 由于我们所选择的数据集中这种汇总类型的人口较少,我们无法确认季节性汇总类别的任何影响,但在今后的调查中应考虑到这一点。 还需要进一步研究真正的多年期数据集,以评估在深时间模型中采集日期的定位编码方法的重要性。

blocks.en: Appendix B Class-wise Performance Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录B 分类性能分析

blocks.en: To better understand the impact of class grouping on crop segmentation datasets, we analyse confusion matrices from our three main models ( D ) to observe the potential effects on model overall performance contributed by the three identified themes of classes, ‘Non-Homogenous’, ‘Taxonomical Aggregates’, and ‘Seasonal Aggregates’ (See sections 2.4 , 3.1 , and 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 为了更好地理解分类组合对作物分块数据集的影响,我们分析我们三个主要模型(D)的混淆矩阵,以观察“非同类”、“分类聚合物”和“海洋聚合物”这三个已确定主题对模型整体性能的潜在影响。 (见第2.4、3.1和5.3节)。

blocks.en: For MTLCC, the highest individual error is seen in around half of ‘Meadow’ class pixels being misidentified as ‘Background’ by all models. This is a classic overlap, and one of the hardest boundaries to define outside the ground truth data, but still represents the only non-homogenous class of the dataset making up a significant portion of the drop in overall performance. The taxonomical aggregate class, ‘Winter Wheat’, also provides a significant amount of the error rates through false positives on pixels belonging to the ‘Winter Spelt’ and ‘Winter Triticale’ classes, which is to be expected, given that both spelt and triticale have biological relation to common wheat. The seasonal aggregate class, ‘Rapeseed’, is actually the highest performing class in the dataset for all three models, which could indicate a combination of unique spectral-temporal phenology with the narrow geographical window of MTLCC lending most parcels to being the same seasonal variant.
blocks.zh: 对于MTLCC来说,最大的个别错误出现在大约一半的"Meadow"类像素被所有模型误认为"背景". 这是一种经典的重叠,也是在地面真实数据之外定义最难的界限之一,但仍然代表了数据集中唯一的非同质类,构成了整体性能下降的很大一部分. 分类集合类 " Winter Wheat " 也通过属于 " Winter Spelt " 和 " Winter Triticale " 类的像素的假阳性提供了大量误差率,这是预料之中的,因为Spelt和triticale都与常见的小麦有生物关系。 季节性综合类 " Rapeseed " 实际上是所有三种模型数据集中最高的表演类,这可以表明独特的光谱-时态现象与MTLCC的狭小地理窗口相结合,将大多数包裹借给同一季节性变体。

blocks.en: Within PASTIS, ‘Meadow’ classes are falsely classified as ‘Background’ to a much lower proportion, but this still represents one of the largest errors in the dataset’s results due to the class balance of ‘Meadow’ being very strong. The other solely non-homogenous class, ‘Grapevine’, also sees a high rate of misidentification as ‘Background’ by all models. All four of PASTIS’ taxonomical aggregate classes perform poorly, with a mean recall across these classes in PASTIS-24 of 60.6% for PAtteRNS p = 2 p=2 , 54.6% for TSViT p = 2 p=2 , and 52.5% for UTAE. In comparison, the set of classes excluding taxonomical aggregates stands at an average recall of 83.4%, 81.0%, and 80.8% respectively for the same models. ‘Mixed Cereal’, predictably, sees scattered but significant confusion with a number of cereals, likely due to the biological overlap. ‘Leguminous Fodder’ is mostly confused with ‘Background’ and ‘Meadow’, which could be due to a lack of solid internal class phenology. ‘Orchard’ is primarily confused with ‘Background’, backing the theory of class phenological representation influence from the grasses interspacing the fruit trees. Further evidence for this comes from it’s second and third most common confusions, ‘Grapevine’ and ‘Meadows‘, both of which have been identified in our review as non-homogenous classes which may have various similar grasses populating their spatial extent. ‘Fruits, Vegetables, & Flowers’ again has major overlap with ‘Background’, but also sees notable confusion with ‘Sunflower’ and ‘Potatoes’ across all models, very likely attributable to biological overlap in these classes due to the taxonomical aggregation.
blocks.zh: 在PASTIS中, " Meadow " 类被错误地归类为 " Background " ,比例要低得多,但这仍然是数据集结果中最大的错误之一,因为 " Meadow " 类平衡非常强。 另一个完全非同类的阶级,“Grapevine”也认为所有模型都把“背景”误认为“背景”的比例很高。 PATSTIS的四类分类汇总分类均表现不佳,PATSTIS-24中的这些分类平均召回率为:PATERNS p = 2 p = 2 p = 2;TSViT p = 2 p = 2;UTAE 52.5%。 相比之下,不包括分类总量的一组类别平均召回率分别为83.4%、81.0%和80.8%。 " 混合谷物 " ,可以预测,可能由于生物重叠而与一些谷物产生分散但明显的混淆。 `Legumism Fodder ' 大多与`Background ' 和`Meadow ' 混淆,这可能是由于缺乏坚实的内部类苯学。 “果园”主要与“背景”混淆, 进一步的证据来自第二、第三常见的混淆, " 葡萄 " 和 " Meadows " 。 在我们的审查中,这两个分类被确定为非同质类,它们可能含有各种类似的草丛,其空间范围也包含在其中。 " Fruits, Vegetables, & Flowers " 与 " Background " 也有重大重叠,但也看到在所有模型中与 " Sunflower " 和 " Potatoes " 的明显混淆,这很可能是由于分类汇总导致这些类别中的生物重叠。

blocks.en: The confusion matrices for PASTIS-24 also show poor performance on ‘Sorghum’, which was not one of our flagged classes, but was a relative minority population class, This class saw most confusion with ’Maize’, which can be explained by close biological relation between the two. The other consistently weak class we saw in PASTIS was ‘Winter Triticale’, which saw a lot of false classification as ‘Soft Winter Wheat’ and ‘Mixed Cereal’, again bringing the influence of a taxonomical aggregate class into play. Overall, models reported vastly higher performances when trained with MTLCC rather than PASTIS, supporting the theory of taxonomical aggregate classes limiting the performance achievable by models on crop segmentation datasets.
blocks.zh: PASTIS-24的混乱矩阵也显示在"高粱"上表现不佳,"高粱"不是我们标榜的阶级之一,而是一个相对的少数人口阶级,这个阶级看到了与"Maize"最大的混乱,这可以从两者之间密切的生物学关系来解释. 在PASTIS中我们看到的另一个一贯薄弱的阶层是“Winter Triticale ” , “Winter Triticale ” , “Winter Triticale ” , “Winter Winter Wheat ” 和 “Mixed Cereal ” 等许多错误的分类,再次将一个分类集合阶层的影响带入其中。 总的来说,模型报告在接受MTLCC而不是PASTIS培训时的性能要高得多,支持分类汇总类理论,从而限制了模型在作物分化数据集上可实现的性能。
